title: Long-term survival (≥2 years) in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis: a systematic review of prolonged survivors.
abstract: PURPOSE: Subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE) is a progressive and often fatal disorder with highly variable survival. This systematic review aimed to characterize long-term survival (≥2 years), remission, and stabilization, and identify determinants of favorable outcomes. METHODS: A systematic review was conducted according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines. Studies including confirmed SSPE cases were considered eligible for inclusion. Individual patient analysis was restricted to cases with ≥2 years of follow-up. Data were extracted at the patient and cohort levels. RESULTS: Analysis of 77 patients demonstrated that survival beyond 2 years is achievable but variable. Survival distribution showed 44.2% surviving 2 to <5 years, 28.6% surviving 5 to <10 years, and 27.3% surviving ≥10 years. Although 62.3% initially achieved remission or stabilization, 31.2% later developed progression, severe disability, or death. Reported factors associated with prolonged survival included treatment responsiveness (62.3%), slow disease progression (24.7%), and relapsing-remitting or biphasic patterns (20.8%). Additional contributors were host-related factors (18.2%), adult-onset disease (10.4%), early diagnosis, and electroencephalographic improvement. Across 31 cohort studies, overall survival remained poor. Survival beyond 2 years was inconsistently reported and varied widely. Remission or stabilization was observed in some studies, but disease progression remained the predominant outcome. Mortality ranged from low to very high across cohorts. Reported factors associated with improved survival included slower disease progression, older age at onset, earlier stage at diagnosis, and use of therapies such as inosine pranobex and interferon. CONCLUSION: SSPE survival outcomes show marked heterogeneity. Although prolonged survival occurs in some, most patients have poor outcomes, emphasizing the importance of early diagnosis and the need for effective therapies.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review examines long-term survival (≥2 years) in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE), a progressive and often fatal disorder. Analyzing 77 patients and 31 cohort studies, the review finds marked heterogeneity in survival outcomes, with 44.2% surviving 2-5 years, 28.6% surviving 5-10 years, and 27.3% surviving ≥10 years. Despite some cases of prolonged survival, most patients have poor outcomes, highlighting the need for early diagnosis and effective therapies.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE) 是一种进行性且通常致命的疾病,生存率差异很大。本系统评价旨在描述长期生存(≥2 年)、缓解和稳定的特征,并确定有利结果的决定因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 根据 PRISMA 2020 指南进行了系统审查。包括确诊 SSPE 病例的研究被认为符合纳入条件。个体患者分析仅限于随访≥2 年的病例。在患者和 队列研究 级别提取数据。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 对 77 名患者的分析表明,超过 2 年的生存期是可以实现的,但存在差异。生存分布显示,44.2% 的生存时间为 2 至 <5 年,28.6% 的生存时间为 5 至 <10 年,27.3% 的生存时间≥10 年。尽管 62.3% 的患者最初获得缓解或稳定,但 31.2% 的患者后来出现病情进展、严重残疾或死亡。报告的与延长生存期相关的因素包括 治疗 反应性 (62.3%)、疾病进展缓慢 (24.7%) 和复发缓解或双相模式 (20.8%)。其他影响因素包括 宿主 相关因素 (18.2%)、成人发病疾病 (10.4%)、早期 诊断 和脑电图改善。在 31 项 队列研究 研究中,总生存率仍然很低。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 超过 2 年的生存率报告不一致且差异很大。一些研究观察到病情缓解或稳定,但疾病进展仍然是主要结果。死亡率 在 队列研究 中的范围从低到非常高。报告的与改善生存相关的因素包括疾病进展较慢、发病年龄较大、诊断 处于早期阶段以及使用肌苷普拉诺和干扰素等疗法。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 尽管某些患者的生存期延长,但大多数患者的预后较差,这强调了早期 诊断 的重要性以及有效治疗的必要性。

title: Measles Immunity and Associated Factors Among Healthcare Workers in Bandar Abbas Following the 2025 Outbreak: A Cross-Sectional Study.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Measles is a highly contagious viral infection that poses significant risks to healthcare workers (HCWs) during outbreaks and can lead to nosocomial transmission. Despite vaccination programmes, immunity gaps persist, as seen in the 2025 Bandar Abbas, Iran, outbreak, necessitating seroprevalence assessments among HCWs in vulnerable regions. To assess measles immunity seroprevalence among Bandar Abbas HCWs following the 2025 outbreak and examine associated demographic factors (age, sex). METHODS: This cross-sectional study surveyed 175 HCWs from three hospitals in Bandar Abbas using convenience sampling (January-April 2025). Data included questionnaires on demographics and vaccination, as well as ELISA-based serological IgG testing. Immunity was categorised as positive or not positive (negative/equivocal). Analyses employed Spearman's correlation, the Mann-Whitney U test, the Chi-square test and logistic regression (p < 0.05). RESULTS: Participants had a mean age of 31.54 ± 7.42 years, and 62.9% were female. All reported prior measles vaccination. Seroprevalence of positive immunity was 74.9%, while 25.1% were not positive. Age showed a significant positive correlation with IgG levels (rho = 0.360, p < 0.001) and with immunity status (U = 1763.500, p < 0.001). Logistic regression revealed that each additional year of age increased the odds of positive immunity by 14.3% (OR = 1.143, 95% CI 1.061-1.232, p < 0.001). There was no significant association with sex (p = 0.813). Vaccination history could not be analysed due to insufficient variation. CONCLUSION: Notable immunity gaps in Bandar Abbas HCWs, especially among younger staff, underscore the need for targeted screening, boosters and enhanced infection control measures.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 麻疹病毒、麻疹 疾病、医护人员、2025 年 暴发 后阿巴斯港的人口,未指定干预措施,主题边界是 HCW 中的 麻疹 免疫评估,中心问题是评估 血清流行率 和相关的人口统计因素。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 横断面研究,对阿巴斯港三家医院的 175 名医护人员进行便利抽样(2025 年 1 月至 4 月),通过问卷调查和基于 ELISA 的血清学 IgG 检测收集数据,使用 Spearman 相关性、Mann-Whitney U 检验、卡方检验和逻辑回归进行统计分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 医护人员中74.9%的血清流行率免疫阳性,25.1%不阳性,均报告过疫苗接种,年龄与IgG水平和免疫状态呈显着正相关,年龄每增加一岁,免疫阳性的几率增加14.3%,与性别无显着相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 由于变异不足、便利抽样的潜在选择偏差、阿巴斯港卫生工作者之外的普遍性有限、未检查的其他人口因素的可能影响,无法分析 疫苗接种 历史。

title_zh: 麻疹 2025 年 麻疹 后阿巴斯港医护人员的免疫力和相关因素:一项横断面研究。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVES: Measles is a highly contagious viral infection that poses significant risks to healthcare workers (HCWs) during outbreaks and can lead to nosocomial transmission. Despite vaccination programmes, immunity gaps persist, as seen in the 2025 Bandar Abbas, Iran, outbreak, necessitating seroprevalence assessments among HCWs in vulnerable regions. To assess measles immunity seroprevalence among Bandar Abbas HCWs following the 2025 outbreak and examine associated demographic factors (age, sex). METHODS: This cross-sectional study surveyed 175 HCWs from three hospitals in Bandar Abbas using convenience sampling (January-April 2025). Data included questionnaires on demographics and vaccination, as well as ELISA-based serological IgG testing. Immunity was categorised as positive or not positive (negative/equivocal). Analyses employed Spearman's correlation, the Mann-Whitney U test, the Chi-square test and logistic regression (p < 0.05). RESULTS: Participants had a mean age of 31.54 ± 7.42 years, and 62.9% were female. All reported prior measles vaccination. Seroprevalence of positive immunity was 74.9%, while 25.1% were not positive. Age showed a significant positive correlation with IgG levels (rho = 0.360, p < 0.001) and with immunity status (U = 1763.500, p < 0.001). Logistic regression revealed that each additional year of age increased the odds of positive immunity by 14.3% (OR = 1.143, 95% CI 1.061-1.232, p < 0.001). There was no significant association with sex (p = 0.813). Vaccination history could not be analysed due to insufficient variation. CONCLUSION: Notable immunity gaps in Bandar Abbas HCWs, especially among younger staff, underscore the need for targeted screening, boosters and enhanced infection control measures.

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 麻疹病毒、麻疹 疾病、医护人员、2025 年 暴发 后阿巴斯港的人口,未指定干预措施,主题边界是 HCW 中的 麻疹 免疫评估,中心问题是评估 血清流行率 和相关的人口统计因素。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 横断面研究,对阿巴斯港三家医院的 175 名医护人员进行便利抽样(2025 年 1 月至 4 月),通过问卷调查和基于 ELISA 的血清学 IgG 检测收集数据,使用 Spearman 相关性、Mann-Whitney U 检验、卡方检验和逻辑回归进行统计分析。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 医护人员中74.9%的血清流行率免疫阳性,25.1%不阳性,均报告过疫苗接种,年龄与IgG水平和免疫状态呈显着正相关,年龄每增加一岁,免疫阳性的几率增加14.3%,与性别无显着相关。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 由于变异不足、便利抽样的潜在选择偏差、阿巴斯港卫生工作者之外的普遍性有限、未检查的其他人口因素的可能影响,无法分析 疫苗接种 历史。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 需要有针对性的筛查计划、加强 疫苗接种 策略、加强感染控制措施(特别是针对年轻医护人员)、进一步研究以调查 疫苗接种 历史影响和其他相关因素。

title: From Seroprevalence to Measles Outbreak Risk: A Multicountry Epidemiological Proof of Concept
abstract: Background: High national vaccination coverage may conceal age-specific and spatially concentrated measles susceptibility. Objective: To assess whether published age-specific seropositivity results can be converted into a time-updated susceptibility profile that corresponds with subsequent measles incidence, while distinguishing susceptibility from infectious introductions and transmission conditions. Methods: For Israel, published 2015 age-specific seropositivity estimates were mapped to monthly birth cohorts and projected to 1 March 2018, accounting for births, aging, maternal antibody, routine vaccination, vaccine effectiveness, and uncertainty in assay interpretation. The primary outcome was reported age-specific incidence during the 2018-2019 outbreak; national and Jerusalem District case burdens were secondary outcomes. Published evidence from the Netherlands, Czechia, and Australia was compared using a common framework covering age distribution, assay classification, vaccination, importation, spatial concentration, and transmission context. Results: The estimated number susceptible in Israel on 1 March 2018 ranged from approximately 0.55 million (6.3% of the modelled population) to 1.92 million (22.4%), with a central estimate of 1.22 million (14.2%). Children aged <1 year had the highest central susceptible proportion (75.7%) and the highest later incidence (196.0 per 100,000). Jerusalem District accounted for 2,202 of 4,311 reported national cases, consistent with susceptibility concentrated in communities with lower first-dose coverage. The external comparisons showed that clustering amplified Dutch outbreak risk, survey design affected Czech estimates, and importation dominated Australian activity. Conclusions: Published seropositivity can identify immunity gaps, but useful outbreak-risk assessment must also represent susceptible density and distribution, introduction pressure, and local transmission conditions. Although the model was not designed to compare alternative vaccination schedules directly, its identification of substantial susceptibility during early childhood provides epidemiological support for Israel's recent decision to advance the second routine MMRV dose from 6 years to 18 months of age, thereby shortening the period during which young children remain dependent on single-dose protection.

For Israel, 2015 age-specific seropositivity estimates were mapped to monthly birth cohorts and projected to 1 March 2018.
analysis.methods: Published seropositivity estimates were mapped to monthly birth cohorts and projected over time, accounting for births, aging, maternal antibody, routine vaccination, vaccine effectiveness, and assay uncertainty. External comparisons used a common framework covering age distribution, assay classification, vaccination, importation, spatial concentration, and transmission context.
analysis.main_results: The estimated number susceptible in Israel on 1 March 2018 ranged from 0.55 million (6.3%) to 1.92 million (22.4%), with a central estimate of 1.22 million (14.2%). Children aged <1 year had the highest central susceptible proportion (75.7%) and incidence (196.0 per 100,000). Jerusalem District accounted for 2,202 of 4,311 national cases, with susceptibility concentrated in communities with lower first-dose coverage.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Published seropositivity can identify immunity gaps, but useful outbreak-risk assessment must also represent susceptible density, introduction pressure, and local transmission conditions. The model identified substantial susceptibility during early childhood, supporting Israel's decision to advance the second MMRV dose from 6 years to 18 months.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform targeted vaccination strategies by highlighting age-specific susceptibility hotspots and the importance of spatial coverage. analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The model was not designed to directly compare alternative vaccination schedules, and external comparisons were limited by varying data quality and outbreak contexts. analysis.summary_en: This multicountry study developed a method to convert seroprevalence data into time-updated measles susceptibility profiles, validated against the 2018-2019 Israeli outbreak. The model estimated 0.55-1.92 million susceptible individuals in Israel (6.3-22.4%), with highest risk in infants (<1 year, 75.7% susceptible, 196/100,000 incidence). Jerusalem District accounted for 51% of cases, reflecting spatial clustering in low-coverage communities. External comparisons showed outbreak risk amplification in the Netherlands due to clustering, survey design effects in Czechia, and importation dominance in Australia. The approach identified early childhood susceptibility gaps, supporting Israel's policy to advance the second MMRV dose from 6 years to 18 months. The study demonstrates that seroprevalence data, when combined with demographic and vaccination dynamics, can predict outbreak risk and guide targeted interventions, though accuracy depends on local transmission conditions and data quality.

analysis_zh.methods: 已发布的血清阳性估计值被映射到每月出生 队列研究 并随着时间的推移进行预测,考虑了出生、衰老、母源抗体、常规 疫苗接种、疫苗 有效性和测定不确定性。外部比较使用一个通用框架,涵盖年龄分布、分析分类、疫苗接种、输入、空间集中和 传播 背景。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 公布的血清阳性可以识别免疫差距,但有用​​的 暴发 风险评估还必须代表易感密度、引入压力和当地 传播 条件。该模型确定了儿童早期的显着易感性,支持以色列将第二次 MMRV 剂量从 6 岁提前到 18 个月的决定。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果通过强调特定年龄的易感性热点和空间覆盖的重要性,为有针对性的 疫苗接种 策略提供信息。他们证明,血清流行率 数据在正确建模时可以预测 暴发 风险并指导政策调整以减少高风险群体中的 传播 窗口。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该模型并非旨在直接比较替代的 疫苗接种 计划,外部比较受到不同数据质量和 暴发 上下文的限制。证据强度中等,因为该方法在生物学上是合理的,并且针对观察到的 暴发 进行了验证,但依赖于有关 疫苗 有效性和测定准确性的假设。

title: Changing epidemiology and transmission dynamics of measles in Ho Chi Minh City: a comparison of the 2018–2020 and 2024–2025 outbreaks
abstract: Abstract Introduction Measles remains a major public health threat worldwide. Following a resurgence of cases, Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) experienced a severe outbreak in 2024–2025 that differed from the 2018–2020 epidemic. We compared the epidemiology and transmission dynamics of these two outbreaks to inform future surveillance and vaccination strategies. Methods Line-list data for measles cases reported in HCMC between 2018 and 2025 were extracted from the infectious disease surveillance system. Demographic changes were assessed using cross-sectional age distributions and longitudinal birth-cohort analyses. Transmission dynamics were characterized by estimating the effective reproduction number (Rt) using the Cori and Wallinga– Teunis methods. Age-stratified Who-Infected-Whom transmission matrices were constructed to quantify within- and between-age-group transmission before and after interventions. Results The 2018–2020 outbreak primarily affected children under five years of age (median age 3.75 years, IQR 0.9–9.1), whereas the 2024–2025 outbreak shifted toward older age groups (median age 8.4 years, IQR 1–14). Birth-cohort analyses identified two major immunity gaps: children born during the COVID-19 immunization disruption (2019–2023) and adolescents and young adults born before 2014 who were not eligible for the 2018 outbreak response immunization campaign. The 2024–2025 outbreak also showed broader spatial spread and a reversed geographic trajectory compared with the earlier epidemic. Transmission patterns changed substantially, with the 2018– 2020 outbreak sustained mainly by transmission among young children, whereas the 2024–2025 outbreak was driven by older age groups, with individuals >15 years acting as an important source of infection for infants. Conclusion The epidemiology of measles in HCMC has shifted from predominantly pediatric transmission to increasing involvement of adolescents and adults, reflecting accumulated immunity gaps across multiple birth cohorts. These findings suggest that age-restricted outbreak response immunization may leave residual susceptible populations that contribute to future outbreaks. Achieving sustainable measles elimination will require vaccination strategies that address historical immunity gaps across all vulnerable age groups, in addition to maintaining high routine childhood vaccination coverage.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the changing epidemiology and transmission dynamics of measles in Ho Chi Minh City, comparing the 2018–2020 and 2024–2025 outbreaks. It highlights a shift from primarily affecting young children to involving older age groups, particularly those over 15 years, who became important sources of infection for infants. The study used line-list data from the infectious disease surveillance system and analyzed demographic changes through cross-sectional age distributions and longitudinal birth-cohort analyses. It also estimated the effective reproduction number (Rt) using the Cori and Wallinga–Teunis methods. The findings suggest that age-restricted immunization campaigns may leave susceptible populations that contribute to future outbreaks, emphasizing the need for vaccination strategies that address immunity gaps across all vulnerable age groups. The study provides important insights for public health planning and surveillance, but it does not report specific limitations of the study design.

title: Risk-targeted interventions for measles control-Lessons from an emergency response project in the Katanga Region, Democratic Republic of the Congo (2021-2023)
abstract: Abstract The Urgepi project is a measles emergency initiative implemented by Médecins Sans Frontières Operational Centre Paris (MSF-OCP) in the Katanga region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, a setting characterized by recurrent measles epidemics with substantial public health impact. To maximize impact, the project employs a risk-targeted approach directing resources to selected health zones to strengthen surveillance, implement preventive vaccination, and ensure timely epidemic response. This study presents the Urgepi approach, and, based on surveillance data from 2021-2023, evaluates the effectiveness of targeted preventive activities, explores strategies for prioritizing interventions amid multiple alerts, and assesses the overall impact of interventions on measles epidemics. Preventive vaccination successfully averted epidemics in six of the nine vaccinated high-risk health zones, while nine of ten non-vaccinated priority health zones experienced large epidemics. In the three vaccinated health zones that experienced epidemics, more locally adapted vaccination strategies would have been required to achieve higher coverage. Regarding the project’s approach to prioritize alerts for investigations and interventions, we found that the Urgepi alert prioritization score was positively associated with subsequent epidemic size, suggesting that this approach allowed effective and timely targeting of larger local measles epidemics. Although no clear impact of epidemic response vaccination on case numbers was observed, likely due to biases introduced in case reporting through provision of free case management, a 50% reduction in the median epidemic duration was recorded. In conclusion, the findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the Urgepi project’s risk-targeted approach for measles prevention and control and highlight the importance of timely and context-specific interventions. Key questions What is already known on this topic – Measles can, in theory, be effectively controlled through preventive vaccination or rapid immunization responses during outbreaks. However, many countries continue to face significant operational challenges. What this study adds – We demonstrate how a risk-targeted approach, with prioritization of both preventive and response actions, can optimize resources in the fight against measles. How this study might affect research, practice or policy – Similar risk-targeted approaches can help national programs prioritize geographic areas for measles prevention and outbreak response when it is not feasible to cover all regions due to operational constraints.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to address operational challenges in measles control in the Katanga region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, where recurrent epidemics have substantial public health impact, and it aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a risk-targeted approach for measles prevention and control.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in the Katanga region of the Democratic Republic of Congo from 2021 to 2023, focusing on selected high-risk health zones, and evaluated the Urgepi project's risk-targeted approach using surveillance data.
analysis.methods: The study evaluated targeted preventive activities, explored strategies for prioritizing interventions amid multiple alerts, and assessed the impact of interventions on measles epidemics using surveillance data from 2021-2023.
analysis.main_results: Preventive vaccination averted epidemics in six of nine vaccinated high-risk health zones, while nine of ten non-vaccinated priority health zones experienced large epidemics; the Urgepi alert prioritization score was positively associated with subsequent epidemic size; and a 50% reduction in median epidemic duration was recorded.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of the risk-targeted approach for measles prevention and control, highlighting the importance of timely and context-specific interventions, and demonstrated how such an approach can optimize resources in the fight against measles.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform national programs on how to prioritize geographic areas for measles prevention and outbreak response when operational constraints make it infeasible to cover all regions, and demonstrate the value of risk-targeted approaches in optimizing resource allocation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as no clear impact of epidemic response vaccination on case numbers was observed, likely due to biases introduced in case reporting through provision of free case management, and the study's effectiveness is limited to the specific context of the Katanga region.

title_zh: 麻疹 控制的风险针对性干预措施——刚果民主共和国加丹加地区应急响应项目的经验教训(2021-2023 年)
source_body_en: Abstract The Urgepi project is a measles emergency initiative implemented by Médecins Sans Frontières Operational Centre Paris (MSF-OCP) in the Katanga region of the Democratic Republic of Congo, a setting characterized by recurrent measles epidemics with substantial public health impact. To maximize impact, the project employs a risk-targeted approach directing resources to selected health zones to strengthen surveillance, implement preventive vaccination, and ensure timely epidemic response. This study presents the Urgepi approach, and, based on surveillance data from 2021-2023, evaluates the effectiveness of targeted preventive activities, explores strategies for prioritizing interventions amid multiple alerts, and assesses the overall impact of interventions on measles epidemics. Preventive vaccination successfully averted epidemics in six of the nine vaccinated high-risk health zones, while nine of ten non-vaccinated priority health zones experienced large epidemics. In the three vaccinated health zones that experienced epidemics, more locally adapted vaccination strategies would have been required to achieve higher coverage. Regarding the project’s approach to prioritize alerts for investigations and interventions, we found that the Urgepi alert prioritization score was positively associated with subsequent epidemic size, suggesting that this approach allowed effective and timely targeting of larger local measles epidemics. Although no clear impact of epidemic response vaccination on case numbers was observed, likely due to biases introduced in case reporting through provision of free case management, a 50% reduction in the median epidemic duration was recorded. In conclusion, the findings demonstrate the effectiveness of the Urgepi project’s risk-targeted approach for measles prevention and control and highlight the importance of timely and context-specific interventions. Key questions What is already known on this topic – Measles can, in theory, be effectively controlled through preventive vaccination or rapid immunization responses during outbreaks. However, many countries continue to face significant operational challenges. What this study adds – We demonstrate how a risk-targeted approach, with prioritization of both preventive and response actions, can optimize resources in the fight against measles. How this study might affect research, practice or policy – Similar risk-targeted approaches can help national programs prioritize geographic areas for measles prevention and outbreak response when it is not feasible to cover all regions due to operational constraints.
abstract_zh: 摘要 Urgepi 项目是无国界医生组织巴黎行动中心 (MSF-OCP) 在刚果民主共和国加丹加地区实施的一项 麻疹 紧急举措,该地区经常出现 麻疹 流行病,对公共卫生造成重大影响。为了最大限度地发挥影响,该项目采用以风险为目标的方法,将资源引导到选定的卫生区,以加强监测,实施预防性疫苗接种,并确保及时应对疫情。本研究提出了Urgepi方法,并基于2021-2023年麻疹数据,评估有针对性的预防活动的有效性,探索在多个警报中优先干预的策略,并评估干预措施对麻疹流行病的总体影响。预防性疫苗接种在9个接种疫苗的高风险卫生区中的6个成功避免了流行病,而10个未接种疫苗的重点卫生区中的9个出现了大规模流行病。在经历过流行病的三个疫苗接种卫生区,需要采取更适合当地的 疫苗接种 策略才能实现更高的覆盖率。关于该项目确定调查和干预警报优先级的方法,我们发现 Urgepi 警报优先级评分与随后的流行病规模呈正相关,这表明这种方法可以有效、及时地针对较大的当地 麻疹 流行病。尽管没有观察到流行病应对 疫苗接种 对病例数的明显影响,可能是由于通过提供免费病例管理在病例报告中引入了偏差,但流行病持续时间中位数减少了 50%。总之,研究结果证明了 Urgepi 项目针对 麻疹 预防和控制的风险针对性方法的有效性,并强调了及时和针对具体情况的干预措施的重要性。关键问题 关于该主题的已知信息 – 理论上,可以通过预防性 麻疹 或 麻疹 期间的快速免疫反应来有效控制 麻疹。然而,许多国家继续面临重大的运营挑战。这项研究的补充内容——我们展示了以风险为目标的方法,并优先考虑预防和响应行动,可以在对抗 麻疹 的斗争中优化资源。这项研究可能如何影响研究、实践或政策——当由于操作限制而无法覆盖所有地区时,类似的风险目标方法可以帮助国家计划优先考虑 麻疹 预防和 麻疹 应对的地理区域。

title: Investigating the Trifecta of Measles Cases, Vaccination Rates, and Homeschooling in the United States
abstract: The resurgence in measles cases in the United States over the past couple of years has sparked concern among the populace in the sphere of increased hospitalizations and mortality rates despite the availability of a well tolerated and effective vaccine. Measles is a highly contagious viral disease which is spread through the air via aerosols and respiratory droplets and primarily affects younger individuals. A study was done to assess the effect of homeschooling and vaccination rates on Measles cases employing statistical tests multiple regression and Pearson correlation coefficient. Independent variables comprised MMR average vaccination rates from 2015 to 2025, and homeschooling data from 2024. Regression analysis revealed homeschooling had a significant effect on the number of measles cases (P=.004) with a positive correlation (r=0.4, P=0.01). The vaccination rate variable was not found to be statistically significant, however the correlation coefficient was positive (r=0.06, P>0.05). These findings add to the current body of knowledge as researchers continue to explore causes for the recent spike in measles cases in the United States.

analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study identifies a significant correlation between homeschooling and measles cases but does not establish causation, and the vaccination rate variable was not statistically significant.

Measles is a highly contagious viral disease which is spread through the air via aerosols and respiratory droplets and primarily affects younger individuals. A study was done to assess the effect of homeschooling and vaccination rates on Measles cases employing statistical tests multiple regression and Pearson correlation coefficient. Independent variables comprised MMR average vaccination rates from 2015 to 2025, and homeschooling data from 2024. Regression analysis revealed homeschooling had a significant effect on the number of measles cases (P=.004) with a positive correlation (r=0.4, P=0.01). These findings add to the current body of knowledge as researchers continue to explore causes for the recent spike in measles cases in the United States.

title: Measles and Rubella Elimination Trends in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region, 2023–2024: Progress and Recent Epidemiological Shifts
abstract: Background: Measles and rubella remain key indicators of immunization system performance and are central to the Immunization Agenda 2030 (IA2030). Disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic have widened immunity gaps and accelerated resurgence of vaccine-preventable diseases across multiple regions. This study assesses progress toward measles and rubella elimination in the WHO Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR) during 2023–2024. Methods: We conducted a retrospective descriptive analysis of measles and rubella surveillance data, WHO/UNICEF Estimates of National Immunization Coverage (WUENIC), and Joint Reporting Form (eJRF) data for all 22 EMR countries and territories. Key indicators included disease incidence, MCV1 and MCV2 coverage, surveillance performance metrics, and verified elimination status. Results: Regional measles incidence increased from 110.8 to 116.3 per million population, while rubella incidence more than doubled from 1.9 to 4.3 per million. Large outbreaks in Yemen, Iraq, and Afghanistan disproportionally drove regional trends. MCV1 coverage remained stable at approximately 80%, while MCV2 coverage increased marginally from 73% to 75%. Only nine of 22 countries achieved ≥95% coverage for both doses in 2024. Persistent zero-dose populations, high dropout rates, and ongoing immunity gaps sustained transmission across multiple settings. Conclusions: The EMR remains off track to achieve measles and rubella elimination by 2030. Accelerated, equity-focused efforts are urgently needed to strengthen routine immunization systems, reduce zero-dose population, enhance surveillance capacity, and improve outbreak response—particularly in fragile and conflicted-affected settings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 麻疹 和风疹仍然是免疫系统绩效的关键指标,也是 2030 年免疫议程 (IA2030) 的核心。COVID-19 大流行造成的破坏扩大了免疫差距,并加速了 疫苗 可预防疾病在多个地区的死灰复燃。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究评估了 2023 年至 2024 年世卫组织东地中海区域 (EMR) 在 麻疹 和消除风疹方面取得的进展。关键指标包括疾病 发病率、MCV1 和 MCV2 覆盖率、监测 绩效指标以及经过验证的消除状态。
elements_zh.methods: 我们对所有 22 个 EMR 国家和地区的 麻疹 和风疹 监测 数据、世界卫生组织/联合国儿童基金会国家免疫覆盖率估算 (WUENIC) 以及联合报告表 (eJRF) 数据进行了回顾性描述性分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 区域性 麻疹 发病率 从每百万人口 110.8 增加到 116.3,而风疹 发病率 从每百万人口 1.9 增加到 4.3,增加了一倍多。也门、伊拉克和阿富汗的大型 暴发 不成比例地推动了区域趋势。MCV1 覆盖率稳定在 80% 左右,而 MCV2 覆盖率从 73% 略有上升至 75%。到 2024 年,22 个国家中只有 9 个国家的两种剂量覆盖率达到 ≥95%。持续的零剂量人群、高退出率和持续的免疫差距在多种环境下维持了 传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: EMR 仍无法实现到 2030 年实现 麻疹 和消除风疹的目标。迫切需要加速、注重公平的努力,以加强常规免疫系统、减少零剂量人群、增强 麻疹 能力并改善 监测 应对——特别是在脆弱和受冲突影响的环境中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要采取有针对性的干预措施来解决免疫差距并加强电子病历中的免疫系统,特别是在经历 暴发 和低 疫苗接种 覆盖率的国家。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究基于回顾性数据,并未考虑免疫实践或 暴发 动态的实时变化。由于依赖于报告的数据而不是直接观察或实验验证,证据的强度中等。

title: Seroprevalence of measles-specific IgM and IgG antibodies among children (0–12 years) with measles-like symptoms: a hospital-based cross-sectional study in Northeast Nigeria
abstract: Nigeria has one of the highest measles burdens and the lowest vaccination coverage worldwide. The WHO AFRO region, including Nigeria, is currently working towards a revised target of eliminating measles by 2030. Nigeria’s strategy includes improving MCV1 coverage at 9 months, supplemental immunization for children aged 9–59 months, and intensified case-based surveillance. Recently, MCV2 was introduced and is being piloted. Achieving at least 95% coverage with MCV2 at 15 months is essential for herd immunity. Despite these efforts, measles outbreaks persist, worsened by armed conflicts and the COVID-19 pandemic in Northeast Nigeria which disrupts health infrastructures and ultimately affects immunization activities. This study evaluates serological patterns and confirms measles infection among symptomatic children attending healthcare facilities in Northeast Nigeria. By integrating serology with socio-demographic and clinical risk factors, we seek to evaluate the serological profile and identify proportion of susceptible individuals among symptomatic children in some selected clinical settings in Northeast Nigeria. Children with clinically suspected measles cases were recruited from selected primary healthcare centres (PHC) in Yobe, Borno and Adamawa between November 2022-July 2023. The study analysed serum samples for measles-specific IgM antibodies ( n = 558) and measles-specific IgG antibodies ( n = 372). IgM antibodies were determined using the EUROIMMUN measles virus IgM ELISA kit, and IgG antibodies were determined using the Calbiotech measles IgG kit. Odds Ratio (OR) and 95% Confidence Intervals (CI) were calculated from 2 × 2 tables using a Univariate Logistic Regression model. The association between measles and socio-demographic and risk factors was analysed using chi-square. Statistical significance was set at P ≤ 0.05. In this study, seroprevalence was defined by the presence of IgM to indicate recent infection and IgG to indicate past exposure or immunity. The results showed a seroprevalence of 29.2% for measles IgM and 32.8% for measles IgG. Measles IgM and IgG antibodies were detected more among males compared to females, with a seroprevalence of 30.6% and 33.3% respectively. No significant association was observed between sex and Measles virus seropositivity for either IgM or IgG ( P > 0.05). Although the odds ratio for males was 1.23, the 95% confidence interval (0.82–1.82) indicated that this difference was not statistically significant. The highest IgM and IgG antibodies were observed amongst children aged 1–3 years with a prevalence of 40.8% and 46.5% respectively. Vaccination was associated with a significant reduction in the odds of measles infection (OR 0.30; 95% CI, 0.20–0.44; P ≤ 0.005). This study is limited by potential selection and recall biases. By focusing exclusively on children presenting with measles-like symptoms, the findings are not representative of the general paediatric population. Furthermore, reliance on parental recall for vaccination history introduces a high likelihood of information bias. Our study identifies a high frequency of measles seropositivity among symptomatic children in selected healthcare facilities in Adamawa, Borno and Yobe states. While this study highlights a high prevalence of non-vaccination among symptomatic children, further research should focus on the need for localised investigation into immunization history in symptomatic cases.

title_zh: 具有 麻疹 样症状的儿童(0-12 岁)中 麻疹 特异性 IgM 和 IgG 抗体的 血清流行率:尼日利亚东北部医院的横断面研究
source_body_en: Nigeria has one of the highest measles burdens and the lowest vaccination coverage worldwide. The WHO AFRO region, including Nigeria, is currently working towards a revised target of eliminating measles by 2030. Nigeria’s strategy includes improving MCV1 coverage at 9 months, supplemental immunization for children aged 9–59 months, and intensified case-based surveillance. Recently, MCV2 was introduced and is being piloted. Achieving at least 95% coverage with MCV2 at 15 months is essential for herd immunity. Despite these efforts, measles outbreaks persist, worsened by armed conflicts and the COVID-19 pandemic in Northeast Nigeria which disrupts health infrastructures and ultimately affects immunization activities. This study evaluates serological patterns and confirms measles infection among symptomatic children attending healthcare facilities in Northeast Nigeria. By integrating serology with socio-demographic and clinical risk factors, we seek to evaluate the serological profile and identify proportion of susceptible individuals among symptomatic children in some selected clinical settings in Northeast Nigeria. Children with clinically suspected measles cases were recruited from selected primary healthcare centres (PHC) in Yobe, Borno and Adamawa between November 2022-July 2023. The study analysed serum samples for measles-specific IgM antibodies ( n = 558) and measles-specific IgG antibodies ( n = 372). IgM antibodies were determined using the EUROIMMUN measles virus IgM ELISA kit, and IgG antibodies were determined using the Calbiotech measles IgG kit. Odds Ratio (OR) and 95% Confidence Intervals (CI) were calculated from 2 × 2 tables using a Univariate Logistic Regression model. The association between measles and socio-demographic and risk factors was analysed using chi-square. Statistical significance was set at P ≤ 0.05. In this study, seroprevalence was defined by the presence of IgM to indicate recent infection and IgG to indicate past exposure or immunity. The results showed a seroprevalence of 29.2% for measles IgM and 32.8% for measles IgG. Measles IgM and IgG antibodies were detected more among males compared to females, with a seroprevalence of 30.6% and 33.3% respectively. No significant association was observed between sex and Measles virus seropositivity for either IgM or IgG ( P > 0.05). Although the odds ratio for males was 1.23, the 95% confidence interval (0.82–1.82) indicated that this difference was not statistically significant. The highest IgM and IgG antibodies were observed amongst children aged 1–3 years with a prevalence of 40.8% and 46.5% respectively. Vaccination was associated with a significant reduction in the odds of measles infection (OR 0.30; 95% CI, 0.20–0.44; P ≤ 0.005). This study is limited by potential selection and recall biases. By focusing exclusively on children presenting with measles-like symptoms, the findings are not representative of the general paediatric population. Furthermore, reliance on parental recall for vaccination history introduces a high likelihood of information bias. Our study identifies a high frequency of measles seropositivity among symptomatic children in selected healthcare facilities in Adamawa, Borno and Yobe states. While this study highlights a high prevalence of non-vaccination among symptomatic children, further research should focus on the need for localised investigation into immunization history in symptomatic cases.

title: Evaluation of measles and acute flaccid paralysis surveillance systems in Southern Province, Zambia, 2022 - 2024
abstract: Abstract Background: The Vaccine-Preventable Disease (VPD) surveillance system in Zambia integrates routine immunization monitoring with disease surveillance to guide control measures. In 2022, Zambia recorded 422 measles cases and 37 deaths, with Southern Province recording the highest case fatality rate (11.2%), suggesting possible weaknesses in surveillance performance and outbreak response systems. This evaluation assessed the measles and acute flaccid paralysis (AFP) surveillance systems in Southern province of Zambia from 2022 to 2024. Methods: We conducted a cross-sectional surveillance system evaluation following the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) guidelines. We purposively selected three districts and three facilities from each district, based on measles and AFP case burden and vaccination coverage. We collected data on system’s simplicity, usefulness, and acceptability from 27 participants using structured questionnaires. We also collected data from the electronic Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response (eIDSR) system and World Health Organization databases to assess, data completeness, timeliness, and accuracy. Results were summarized using frequencies and percentages. Results: The measles and AFP surveillance systems comprised both passive and active surveillance operating across community, health facility, district, and provincial levels. The systems demonstrated high levels of simplicity (mean score: 84.6%), usefulness (90.5%), and acceptability (90.8%). However, surveillance performance was limited by suboptimal data quality, with mean completeness of 66.7%, timeliness of 51.1%, and data accuracy of 50%. We also identified key operational challenges of inadequate specimen transportation and insufficient program funding. Conclusion: The measles and AFP surveillance systems in Southern Province are functional, simple, acceptable, and well-integrated into routine services. However, significant gaps in data quality limit their effectiveness for early outbreak detection and timely public health response. Strengthening data management, specimen transport, and sustainable program financing will be critical to improving surveillance performance and accelerating progress toward vaccine-preventable disease control and elimination targets. Keywords: Acute Flaccid Paralysis (AFP), measles, surveillance systems, vaccine-preventable disease, Zambia.

abstract_zh: 摘要背景:赞比亚的 疫苗-可预防疾病 (VPD) 监测 系统将常规免疫监测与疾病 监测 相结合,以指导控制措施。2022年,赞比亚记录了422例麻疹病例和37例死亡,其中南部省的病死率最高(11.2%),这表明监测的表现和暴发反应系统可能存在缺陷。本次评估评估了 2022 年至 2024 年赞比亚南部省的 麻疹 和急性弛缓性麻痹 (AFP) 监测 系统。方法:我们按照疾病控制和预防中心 (CDC) 指南进行了横断面 监测 系统评估。根据 麻疹 和 AFP 案件负担以及 疫苗接种 覆盖范围,我们有目的地选择了三个地区和每个地区的三个设施。我们使用结构化问卷从 27 名参与者那里收集了有关系统简单性、实用性和可接受性的数据。我们还从电子综合疾病 监测 和响应 (eIDSR) 系统和世界卫生组织数据库收集数据,以评估数据的完整性、及时性和准确性。使用频率和百分比总结结果。结果:麻疹 和 AFP 监测 系统包括在社区、卫生机构、地区和省级运行的被动和主动 麻疹 系统。这些系统表现出高度的简单性(平均分:84.6%)、实用性(90.5%)和可接受性(90.8%)。然而,监测 的性能受到数据质量次优的限制,平均完整性为 66.7%,及时性为 51.1%,数据准确性为 50%。我们还确定了标本运输不足和计划资金不足的关键运营挑战。结论:南方省的麻疹和AFP 监测系统功能齐全、简单、可接受,并且很好地融入日常服务。然而,数据质量的巨大差距限制了其早期 暴发 检测和及时公共卫生响应的有效性。加强数据管理、标本运输和可持续项目融资对于提高 监测 绩效和加快实现 疫苗 可预防疾病控制和消除目标至关重要。关键词:急性弛缓性麻痹 (AFP)、麻疹、监测 系统、疫苗 可预防疾病、赞比亚。

title: Preliminary safety data from a randomised trial of early versus standard timing of administration of measles-rubella vaccine in Ugandan infants
abstract: Abstract Background Measles remains a major cause of child morbidity and mortality in low-resource settings. Young infants are particularly at risk of severe disease, with many lacking protective levels of maternal antibodies by six months. Vaccination before nine months in high-burden settings may confer earlier protection; however, concerns exist about its effectiveness at this age. We present early findings on enrolment, safety, and measles infections following the administration of a registered measles-containing vaccine at six months versus nine months (MR1) with a subsequent booster (MR2) at 12 or 18 months of age. Methods We conducted an open-label randomised controlled non-inferiority trial at four health facilities in Kampala, Uganda. Infants aged 24–28 weeks were randomly assigned to receive MR at six and 12 months (group A), nine and 18 months (group B) or six and 18 months (group C). Infants were electronically randomised in a 1:1:1 ratio using block randomisation of varying sizes, stratified by site, maternal HIV status and baseline haemoglobin level. Caretakers recorded solicited reactions on paper diary cards, with safety-related events evaluated. Findings 450 infants received MR1 and were enrolled. No differences in local or systemic post-vaccination events between the six and nine months MR1 groups were observed [Local: 21·2% versus 21·9% ( p = 0·959), systemic: 29·2% vs. 27·7% ( p = 0·845)]. Most local reactions were mild and within the first four days. The majority (5/6) of hospitalisations followed common childhood illnesses, with one non-vaccine-related death six months post-MR1. Sixteen laboratory-confirmed cases of measles (10) and rubella (6), and three clinical measles cases before MR1 were registered. Most measles cases (70·0%) occurred in group C, with no measles cases registered two weeks post-MR2. Conclusion We provide further evidence on the safety of administering a measles-containing vaccine at six months of age. Trial registration : The trial was registered on 31st October 2024 with Clinicaltrials.gov with the identifier NCT06667206.

abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 麻疹 仍然是资源匮乏地区儿童发病和 死亡率 的主要原因。年幼的婴儿尤其面临严重疾病的风险,许多婴儿在六个月时缺乏保护性母体抗体水平。在高负担环境中九个月前使用 疫苗接种 可能会提供更早的保护;然而,人们对其在这个年龄段的有效性存在担忧。我们提出了有关注册、安全性和 麻疹 感染的早期研究结果,这些结果是在 6 个月龄与 9 个月龄(MR1)给予注册的含有 麻疹 的 麻疹 以及随后在 12 或 18 个月龄时进行加强注射(MR2)后的结果。方法 我们在乌干达坎帕拉的四个卫生机构进行了一项开放标签随机对照非劣效性试验。24-28 周的婴儿被随机分配在 6 个月和 12 个月(A 组)、9 个月和 18 个月(B 组)或 6 个月和 18 个月(C 组)时接受 MR。使用不同规模的分组随机化,按地点、母亲艾滋病毒状况和基线血红蛋白水平分层,以 1:1:1 的比例对婴儿进行电子随机化。看护人员将请求的反应记录在纸质日记卡上,并对安全相关事件进行评估。结果 450 名婴儿接受了 MR1 并被登记。在 6 个月和 9 个月的 MR1 组之间,未观察到 疫苗接种 后局部或全身事件的差异 [局部:21·2% 与 21·9% (p = 0·959),全身:29·2% 与 27·7% (p = 0·845)]。大多数局部反应都是轻微的,并且发生在最初的四天内。大多数 (5/6) 的住院治疗是因为常见的儿童疾病,其中 1 例与 疫苗 无关的死亡发生在 MR1 后六个月。登记了 16 例实验室确诊的 麻疹 病例(10 例)和风疹病例(6 例),以及 MR1 之前的 3 例临床 麻疹 病例。大多数 麻疹 病例 (70·0%) 发生在 C 组,MR2 后两周没有登记 麻疹 病例。结论 我们提供了关于在六个月大时给予含有 麻疹 的 疫苗 的安全性的进一步证据。试验注册:该试验于 2024 年 10 月 31 日在 ClinicalTrials.gov 注册,标识符为 NCT06667206。

title: Distinct Humoral Response Development to Measles Virus across Vaccine Platforms 2251461
abstract: Abstract Introduction As measles incidences increase globally, it is imperative to elucidate the features of a protective humoral response. Methods In this study, a phage-display immunoprecipitation sequencing technology, VirScan, was employed to evaluate viral epitope coverage by antibodies raised to infection of rhesus macaques with wild-type (WT) measles virus (MeV), or after vaccination with a live-attenuated MeV vaccine (LAMV), the triple measles mumps rubella vaccine (MMR) or a novel recombinant MeV hemagglutinin protein-based vaccine (rMeVH). Vaccinated animals were also challenged with WT MeV to measure antibody epitope reactivity during a recall. Results The results demonstrate that WT MeV infection elicited antibodies with a broader epitope reactivity profile than LAMV-containing vaccines. The rMeVH vaccine not only resulted in a narrow H-protein specific antibody profile, but induced specificities that were distinct from those induced to WT MeV or LAMV. All vaccinated animals expanded the breadth of their MeV-specific antibody binding repertoires following WT MeV challenge. The MeV-specific VarScore, a measure of overall antigen-binding, was positively correlated with total IgG titers assessed by ELISA, avidity, and neutralizing titer. Conclusion These results demonstrate the large effects of vaccination platforms on the breadth and fine-specificity of anti-measles induced humoral responses. Funding Source NIH Topic Categories Vaccines and Immunotherapy (VAC)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the humoral response to measles virus across different vaccine platforms in rhesus macaques. elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为有针对性的公共卫生干预措施提供信息,以提高服务不足地区的 麻疹 疫苗 覆盖率,从而有可能降低 麻疹 的风险并增强疾病控制策略。

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on measles immunisation services in Indonesia, focusing on the period from 2018 to 2024. It highlights how disruptions during the pandemic may have created immunisation debt, potentially leading to measles resurgence. The research uses longitudinal ecological data from 34–38 provinces, divided into pre-pandemic, pandemic, and post-pandemic phases, to examine measles outbreak frequency and MR1 vaccination coverage. The results show significant differences in KLB frequency across these phases, suggesting a link between pandemic-related service disruptions and measles resurgence. The authors interpret these findings as evidence of the need for targeted immunisation catch-up programs to mitigate the risk of outbreaks. The study's ecological design limits its ability to establish causal relationships, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the reliance on aggregated data. These findings have important implications for public health planning and measles control strategies in Indonesia and other regions with similar challenges.

title: Investigation of measles outbreak in Pakistan (2022 to 2023): Exploring comorbidities, complications, and molecular characterization
abstract: BACKGROUND Measles remains a major public health concern worldwide, particularly in regions with insufficient vaccination coverage and healthcare infrastructure, like Pakistan. The purpose of this study is to investigate the epidemiological, molecular, and phylogenetic characteristics of the measles outbreak in Pakistan during 2022-2023 and highlight the areas of improvement that can contribute to the better understanding of the disease and inform strategies for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization. METHODS Throat swabs were collected from patients (n = 183) admitted at PIMS, Islamabad, Pakistan, from December 2022- December 2023. Statistical analysis of data was conducted on SPSS-21 software. The phylogenetics, amino acid substitutions, their functional analysis, and structural analysis of partial nucleoprotein were performed by using different bioinformatics software. RESULTS Most of the measles patients were infants with a high prevalence of comorbidity and complications, and significant number of patients had inadequate vaccination coverage. The phylogenetic analysis revealed relatedness to B3 strains circulating in Russia and the USA, emphasizing the global spread. The amino acid substitutions and structure analysis highlighted minor structural variations in current isolates as compared to the reference strain. CONCLUSION The findings underscore the importance of continuous surveillance and understanding of measles epidemiology and viral variations for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization, ultimately aiming to mitigate the morbidity and mortality associated with measles outbreaks in Pakistan and similar settings globally. This study exemplifies the significance of interdisciplinary collaboration in confronting complex infectious disease challenges, emphasizing the imperative of continuous monitoring and preparedness in combating measles through vaccination.

The phylogenetics, amino acid substitutions, their functional analysis, and structural analysis of partial nucleoprotein were performed by using different bioinformatics software. RESULTS Most of the measles patients were infants with a high prevalence of comorbidity and complications, and significant number of patients had inadequate vaccination coverage. The phylogenetic analysis revealed relatedness to B3 strains circulating in Russia and the USA, emphasizing the global spread. The amino acid substitutions and structure analysis highlighted minor structural variations in current isolates as compared to the reference strain. CONCLUSION The findings underscore the importance of continuous surveillance and understanding of measles epidemiology and viral variations for effective outbreak management and vaccination optimization, ultimately aiming to mitigate the morbidity and mortality associated with measles outbreaks in Pakistan and similar settings globally. This study exemplifies the significance of interdisciplinary collaboration in confronting complex infectious disease challenges, emphasizing the imperative of continuous monitoring and preparedness in combating measles through vaccination.

title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

title: Measles Prediction Modeling using Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN)
abstract: Measles, a viral and communicable illness with life-threatening complications, begins with an 8-12-day incubation period accompanied by fever, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis. The Measles Virus (MeV) enters the alveolar macrophages of the host or its dendritic cells, replicates, and then spreads to the surrounding surfaces. As a result, we focus on the use of Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for the prediction of measles. The models (ANFIS and ANN) were employed and evaluated using the coefficient of determination (R2), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Pearson correlation coefficient (R), and Percentage Bias (PBIAS) as evaluation metrics. The results showed that ANFIS, ANN, and MLR showed R values of 0.9810, 0.9960, and 0.9750 for both training and test. Remarkably, ANN scored lower in terms of the RMSE metric with values of 0.6790 and 0.6809 for both training and testing. In addition, the ANN PBIAS values were 0.1080 and 0.1142 for both training and testing, respectively. In conclusion, ANFIS and ANN have demonstrated effectiveness in modeling measles occurrences, thus, as a valuable tool for public health and decision makers, especially in determining strategies that will enhance public safety.

The Measles Virus (MeV) enters the alveolar macrophages of the host or its dendritic cells, replicates, and then spreads to the surrounding surfaces. As a result, we focus on the use of Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Inference Systems (ANFIS) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) for the prediction of measles. The models (ANFIS and ANN) were employed and evaluated using the coefficient of determination (R2), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), Pearson correlation coefficient (R), and Percentage Bias (PBIAS) as evaluation metrics. The results showed that ANFIS, ANN, and MLR showed R values of 0.9810, 0.9960, and 0.9750 for both training and test. Remarkably, ANN scored lower in terms of the RMSE metric with values of 0.6790 and 0.6809 for both training and testing. In addition, the ANN PBIAS values were 0.1080 and 0.1142 for both training and testing, respectively. In conclusion, ANFIS and ANN have demonstrated effectiveness in modeling measles occurrences, thus, as a valuable tool for public health and decision makers, especially in determining strategies that will enhance public safety.

abstract_zh: 麻疹 是一种病毒性传染性疾病,具有危及生命的并发症,开始时有 8-12 天的潜伏期,伴有发烧、咳嗽、鼻炎和结膜炎。麻疹病毒 (MeV) 进入 宿主 的肺泡巨噬细胞或其树突状细胞,进行复制,然后扩散到周围表面。因此,我们重点关注使用自适应神经模糊推理系统 (ANFIS) 和人工神经网络 (ANN) 来预测 麻疹。使用决定系数 (R2)、均方根误差 (RMSE)、皮尔逊相关系数 (R) 和百分比偏差 (PBIAS) 作为评估指标来采用和评估模型(ANFIS 和 ANN)。结果表明,ANFIS、ANN 和 MLR 在训练和测试中的 R 值为 0.9810、0.9960 和 0.9750。值得注意的是,ANN 在 RMSE 指标方面的得分较低,训练和测试的值为 0.6790 和 0.6809。此外,训练和测试的 ANN PBIAS 值分别为 0.1080 和 0.1142。总之,ANFIS 和 ANN 在建模 麻疹 事件方面证明了有效性,因此,作为公共卫生和决策者的宝贵工具,特别是在确定增强公共安全的策略方面。

title: Country-level immunization recovery and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden after COVID-19: a descriptive ecological analysis of WUENIC, 2010-2024.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Global immunization averages can obscure entity-level shortfalls in access, series completion, measles coverage, and recovery from 2019. We assessed these signals. METHODS: The primary analysis used exact-2024-revision WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records for 194 countries/reporting entities during 2010-2024. We estimated recovery from 2019 and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden, quantified DTP3-MCV1 overlap, and assigned ordered phenotypes. We reproduced benchmarks and conducted source-status, target-population-weighted, threshold, and exact-2025-revision sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: Reproduced weighted 2024 estimates were 88.94% for DTP1, 84.56% for DTP3, and 84.03% for MCV1. Unweighted country fixed-effects estimates for 2024 versus 2019 were - 1.80 percentage points (95% CI -2.75 to -0.84) for DTP1, -2.09 (-3.25 to -0.93) for DTP3, and - 1.65 (-2.72 to -0.58) for MCV1; target-population-weighted estimates were closer to zero and imprecise. The DTP1 no-dose proxy count was 14.26 million; the top 20 entities accounted for 74.6%. Forty-five entities with DTP3 below 80% and MCV1 below 90% accounted for 72.8% of the proxy count. Threshold changes reassigned at most 13.4% of entities. With exact-2025-revision records and the endpoint fixed at 2024, aggregate metrics were similar, but 20 recovery-class and 19 phenotype assignments changed among 194 common entities. CONCLUSION: Aggregate coverage near 2019 levels coexisted with entity-level access, completion, measles, recovery, and data-review signals. Program managers should review them jointly, not as one ranking; assignments are descriptive and revision-specific, not validated risk scores.

abstract_original: BACKGROUND: Global immunization averages can obscure entity-level shortfalls in access, series completion, measles coverage, and recovery from 2019. We assessed these signals. METHODS: The primary analysis used exact-2024-revision WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records for 194 countries/reporting entities during 2010-2024. We estimated recovery from 2019 and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden, quantified DTP3-MCV1 overlap, and assigned ordered phenotypes. We reproduced benchmarks and conducted source-status, target-population-weighted, threshold, and exact-2025-revision sensitivity analyses. RESULTS: Reproduced weighted 2024 estimates were 88.94% for DTP1, 84.56% for DTP3, and 84.03% for MCV1. Unweighted country fixed-effects estimates for 2024 versus 2019 were - 1.80 percentage points (95% CI -2.75 to -0.84) for DTP1, -2.09 (-3.25 to -0.93) for DTP3, and - 1.65 (-2.72 to -0.58) for MCV1; target-population-weighted estimates were closer to zero and imprecise. The DTP1 no-dose proxy count was 14.26 million; the top 20 entities accounted for 74.6%. Forty-five entities with DTP3 below 80% and MCV1 below 90% accounted for 72.8% of the proxy count. Threshold changes reassigned at most 13.4% of entities. With exact-2025-revision records and the endpoint fixed at 2024, aggregate metrics were similar, but 20 recovery-class and 19 phenotype assignments changed among 194 common entities. CONCLUSION: Aggregate coverage near 2019 levels coexisted with entity-level access, completion, measles, recovery, and data-review signals. Program managers should review them jointly, not as one ranking; assignments are descriptive and revision-specific, not validated risk scores.
title_original: Country-level immunization recovery and DTP1 no-dose proxy burden after COVID-19: a descriptive ecological analysis of WUENIC, 2010-2024.

analysis.summary_en: This descriptive ecological analysis of WHO/UNICEF WUENIC records from 194 countries (2010-2024) reveals that while aggregate immunization coverage returned to near-2019 levels in 2024, significant entity-level shortfalls persist. The DTP1 no-dose proxy burden reached 14.26 million, with the top 20 entities accounting for 74.6% of this burden. Sensitivity analyses, including threshold and revision-based changes, highlight the dynamic nature of these estimates. The findings emphasize the need for program managers to jointly review multiple signals—access, completion, measles coverage, recovery, and data review—rather than relying on single rankings, as assignments are descriptive and revision-specific, not validated risk scores.

title: Ultraviolet-C light for prevention of airborne infection: A baseline analysis of web-based public information.
abstract: Ultraviolet-C (UVC) technology to mitigate airborne infections was first demonstrated in laboratory and epidemiologic studies of influenza and measles in the 1930s, with effectiveness against tuberculosis demonstrated in the 1950s and again in the early 2000s. Yet, UVC was underutilized during the SARS CoV-2 pandemic (COVID-19). Availability, clarity, and actionability of information and messaging on UVC technology may have played a role in limiting policy discussions and uptake of UVC during the COVID-19 pandemic. The purpose of this analysis was to systematically assess the availability, clarity, and actionability of web-based information about UVC for preventing airborne respiratory infections. Student research assistants conducted internet searches using the Google Search engine after receiving a brief orientation to germicidal ultraviolet (GUV) air disinfection. They referred webpages from public health and regulatory organizations whose missions were to regulate UVC or provide recommendations for UVC to prevent transmission of airborne infectious pathogens to the principal investigator (PI). The PI determined whether the webpages met the inclusion criteria. The PI and a doctoral student with experience and training scored the final sample using the CDC's Clear Communication Index (CCI) which assessed public health information on clarity and actionability across four domains. Searches using the Google Search engine for information targeted to the general public yielded mostly commercial websites of UVC vendors, peer-reviewed papers, press releases on UVC research, and public health and regulatory agencies such as the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). We found that the public health and regulatory agencies have much room for improvement in the clarity, actionability, and integration with each other of their messaging and information. The lack of public policy and concerns about safety of UVC may be inhibiting clear and definitive public health messaging. Easily searchable UVC messaging on credible public health and regulatory websites has the potential to translate the peer-reviewed literature for lay audiences and improve public understanding of UVC for reducing airborne infections. In conclusion, this baseline analysis suggests a policy-communication gap in public-facing information about UVC for airborne infection prevention. More integrated, clear, and actionable guidance from neutral, authoritative organizations may support public understanding, informed discussion, and appropriate use of this potentially life-saving approach to protecting people in indoor spaces.

source_body_en: Ultraviolet-C (UVC) technology to mitigate airborne infections was first demonstrated in laboratory and epidemiologic studies of influenza and measles in the 1930s, with effectiveness against tuberculosis demonstrated in the 1950s and again in the early 2000s. They referred webpages from public health and regulatory organizations whose missions were to regulate UVC or provide recommendations for UVC to prevent transmission of airborne infectious pathogens to the principal investigator (PI). The PI determined whether the webpages met the inclusion criteria. The PI and a doctoral student with experience and training scored the final sample using the CDC's Clear Communication Index (CCI) which assessed public health information on clarity and actionability across four domains. Easily searchable UVC messaging on credible public health and regulatory websites has the potential to translate the peer-reviewed literature for lay audiences and improve public understanding of UVC for reducing airborne infections. In conclusion, this baseline analysis suggests a policy-communication gap in public-facing information about UVC for airborne infection prevention. More integrated, clear, and actionable guidance from neutral, authoritative organizations may support public understanding, informed discussion, and appropriate use of this potentially life-saving approach to protecting people in indoor spaces.

title: Strengthening India's pandemic preparedness with the four zonal institutes of virology: stakeholder consultations for outbreak response and collaborative research priorities.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat Health Infrastructure Mission (PM-ABHIM) scheme, supported by the World Bank, is establishing four zonal National Institutes of Virology (NIVs) in India. It is essential to identify the zonal disease and research priorities so as to focus research at zonal levels. This study reports a zonal viral disease prioritisation exercise to support outbreak response and collaborative research. It describes zonal-prioritised viral diseases, assesses concordance and differences in zonal priority lists and, and identifies cross‐cutting research themes and preparedness gaps using an multicriteria decision analysis (MCDA)‐based consensus process. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional, multi-stakeholder consultative study across four geographical zones of India in March 2024. The zonal-level consultative workshops employed a systematic consensus-building approach using the modified One Health Zoonotic Disease Prioritisation (OHZDP) tool, adapted for emerging viral diseases and applied via MCDA. We identified zonal-level stakeholders, listed 40 viral diseases and categorised them into three groups: common occurrence (Group A), limited occurrence (Group B), and rare occurrences with a chance of emergence, evolution or importation (Group C). The stakeholders from state health departments, medical colleges, research institutes and the Virus Research and Diagnostic Laboratory (VRDL) network ranked the viral diseases and research themes in each zone. Spearman rank correlation was used to assess concordance of priority rankings between zones. RESULTS: A total of 186 participants (42-48 per zone) contributed to the four zonal workshops including collaborators from VRDL laboratories (26%), public health stakeholders from Integrated Disease Surveillance programme(IDSP) (28%), invited experts (21%), organisers (19%) and Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) representatives (6%). The key outcomes included the zone-specific lists of priority viral diseases in Groups A, B and C. There were zonal variations in viral disease prioritisation, reflecting local epidemiological patterns. Spearman rank correlation analysis showed moderate positive correlation between the Central and East zones (rho = 0.697, P = 0.031), whereas other pairwise comparisons were not statistically significant, which indicated both shared and distinct priority patterns within the zones. The top five priority viral diseases across zones included dengue, influenza, measles, Japanese encephalitis and hepatitis A. The research themes and subthemes were then decided for collaborative research. CONCLUSIONS: These multistakeholder consultations provided a novel, replicable template for prioritising viral diseases to develop strategies for mitigating the impact of future outbreaks through collaborative research. These zonal priorities may guide similar exercises at national, regional and global levels in future.

It describes zonal-prioritised viral diseases, assesses concordance and differences in zonal priority lists and, and identifies cross‐cutting research themes and preparedness gaps using an multicriteria decision analysis (MCDA)‐based consensus process. METHODS: We conducted a cross-sectional, multi-stakeholder consultative study across four geographical zones of India in March 2024. abstract_zh: 背景:由世界银行支持的 Pradhan Mantri Ayushman Bharat 卫生基础设施任务 (PM-ABHIM) 计划正在印度建立四个区域性国家病毒学研究所 (NIV)。确定区域疾病和研究重点至关重要,以便将研究重点放在区域层面。本研究报告了一项区域性病毒性疾病优先排序活动,以支持 暴发 响应和协作研究。它描述了区域优先的病毒性疾病,评估区域优先列表的一致性和差异,并使用基于多标准决策分析(MCDA)的共识过程确定跨领域的研究主题和准备差距。方法:我们于 2024 年 3 月在印度的四个地理区域开展了一项横断面、多利益相关者协商研究。区域级协商研讨会采用了系统性的共识建立方法,使用了修改后的 One Health 人畜共患疾病优先排序 (OHZDP) 工具,该工具适用于新出现的病毒性疾病,并通过 MCDA 应用。我们确定了区域级利益相关者,列出了 40 种病毒性疾病,并将其分为三组:常见发生(A 组)、有限发生(B 组)和有机会出现、进化 或输入的罕见发生(C 组)。来自州卫生部门、医学院、研究机构和病毒研究与诊断实验室(VRDL)网络的利益相关者对每个区域的病毒性疾病和研究主题进行了排名。斯皮尔曼排名相关性用于评估区域之间优先级排名的一致性。结果:共有 186 名参与者(每个区域 42-48 人)参与了四个区域研讨会,其中包括 VRDL 实验室的合作者 (26%)、综合疾病 监测 计划 (IDSP) 的公共卫生利益相关者 (28%)、特邀专家 (21%)、组织者 (19%) 和印度医学研究委员会 (ICMR) 代表 (6%)。主要成果包括 A、B 和 C 组中特定区域的优先病毒性疾病清单。病毒性疾病优先顺序存在区域差异,反映了当地的流行病学模式。Spearman 等级相关分析显示中部和东部区域之间呈中度正相关(rho = 0.697,P = 0.031),而其他成对比较没有统计显着性,这表明区域内既有共同的又有不同的优先模式。各地区排名前五位的重点病毒性疾病包括登革热、流感、麻疹、日本脑炎和甲型肝炎。然后确定合作研究的研究主题和副主题。结论:这些多利益相关方磋商提供了一个新颖的、可复制的模板,用于优先考虑病毒性疾病,以制定通过合作研究减轻未来 暴发 影响的策略。这些区域优先事项可能会指导未来在国家、区域和全球层面的类似活动。

title: Seroprotection Against Mumps in MMR Vaccinated Children Aged 9-12 Years: A Cross-Sectional Study.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To estimate the proportion of children aged 9-12 years with seroprotective antibody titers against mumps following a single dose of measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine administered in early childhood, and to explore the association between seroprotection and clinicodemographic profile. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted at a tertiary hospital in Delhi between April 2024 and August 2025. Children aged 9-12 years with a documented receipt of a single dose of MMR vaccine at 16-24 months of age were recruited. Two mL of venous blood was collected and analyzed for serum mumps-specific IgG antibodies using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), with seroprotection defined as mumps antibody titers ≥ 22 RU/mL. The association between seroprotection and demographic and clinical variables, including age, sex, age at vaccination, and nutritional status, was assessed using the chi-square test or Fisher's exact test. RESULTS: Eighty-six children (48% males) aged 9-12 years [mean (SD) 10.35 (1.04) years] were enrolled. Overall, 84.8% demonstrated seroprotective antibody titers against mumps. The median (q1, q3) mumps-specific IgG titer was 97.6 (46.1, 144.9) RU/mL. Children aged > 10 years were significantly more likely to be seronegative compared to younger children (OR 3.99, 95% CI 1.07, 14.92, P = 0.039). CONCLUSION: Nearly 85% of children who had received a single MMR dose at 16-24 months of age had seroprotective mumps antibody titers at 9-12 years. The findings highlight the need for larger community-based studies on the durability of mumps immunity and add to the accumulating evidence informing future MMR vaccination strategies in India.

source_records.title: Seroprotection Against Mumps in MMR Vaccinated Children Aged 9-12 Years: A Cross-Sectional Study.
source_records.abstract: OBJECTIVES: To estimate the proportion of children aged 9-12 years with seroprotective antibody titers against mumps following a single dose of measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine administered in early childhood, and to explore the association between seroprotection and clinicodemographic profile. METHODS: A cross-sectional study was conducted at a tertiary hospital in Delhi between April 2024 and August 2025. Children aged 9-12 years with a documented receipt of a single dose of MMR vaccine at 16-24 months of age were recruited. Two mL of venous blood was collected and analyzed for serum mumps-specific IgG antibodies using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), with seroprotection defined as mumps antibody titers ≥ 22 RU/mL. The association between seroprotection and demographic and clinical variables, including age, sex, age at vaccination, and nutritional status, was assessed using the chi-square test or Fisher's exact test. RESULTS: Eighty-six children (48% males) aged 9-12 years [mean (SD) 10.35 (1.04) years] were enrolled. Overall, 84.8% demonstrated seroprotective antibody titers against mumps. The median (q1, q3) mumps-specific IgG titer was 97.6 (46.1, 144.9) RU/mL. Children aged > 10 years were significantly more likely to be seronegative compared to younger children (OR 3.99, 95% CI 1.07, 14.92, P = 0.039). CONCLUSION: Nearly 85% of children who had received a single MMR dose at 16-24 months of age had seroprotective mumps antibody titers at 9-12 years. The findings highlight the need for larger community-based studies on the durability of mumps immunity and add to the accumulating evidence informing future MMR vaccination strategies in India.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study evaluated seroprotection against mumps in children aged 9-12 years who had received a single dose of measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine in early childhood. The study was conducted at a tertiary hospital in Delhi between April 2024 and August 2025. Blood samples were collected and analyzed for mumps-specific IgG antibodies using ELISA, with seroprotection defined as titers ≥ 22 RU/mL. The results showed that 84.8% of the 86 enrolled children had seroprotective antibody titers, with a median titer of 97.6 RU/mL. Children older than 10 years were significantly more likely to be seronegative compared to younger children. The findings suggest the need for further community-based studies to assess the durability of mumps immunity and inform future MMR vaccination strategies in India. However, the study's single-center design and limited sample size may affect generalizability, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在估计在儿童早期施用单剂 麻疹-腮腺炎-风疹 (MMR) 疫苗 后具有针对腮腺炎血清保护性抗体滴度的 9-12 岁儿童的比例,并探讨血清保护与临床人口统计学特征之间的关联。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 4 月至 2025 年 8 月期间,在德里的一家三级医院进行了一项横断面研究。招募了 9-12 岁、有记录在 16-24 个月大时接受过单剂 MMR 疫苗 的儿童。
elements_zh.methods: 收集 2 mL 静脉血,并使用酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 分析血清腮腺炎特异性 IgG 抗体,血清保护定义为腮腺炎抗体滴度≥ 22 RU/mL。使用卡方检验或 Fisher 精确检验评估血清保护与人口统计和临床变量(包括年龄、性别、疫苗接种 年龄和营养状况)之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 纳入了 86 名 9-12 岁儿童(48% 男性)[平均 (SD) 10.35 (1.04) 岁]。总体而言,84.8% 的人表现出针对腮腺炎的血清保护性抗体滴度。中位(q1,q3)腮腺炎特异性 IgG 滴度为 97.6(46.1,144.9)RU/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调需要对流行性腮腺炎免疫力的持久性进行更大规模的社区研究,并为印度未来的 MMR 疫苗接种 战略提供越来越多的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果提供了有关接种 MMR 疫苗的儿童对流行性腮腺炎的长期血清保护作用的见解,这可以为印度未来的 疫苗接种 战略和 监测 工作提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在一家三级医院进行的,这可能会限制普遍性。证据是中等的,因为它基于横截面设计和有限的样本量。

title: Association Between First MMR Vaccination Before Age 2 Years and Childhood Autism in a U.S. EHR Cohort of 2.5 Million Children.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Concerns about potential associations between measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination and autism persist despite extensive prior research. Observational studies evaluating vaccine timing are susceptible to bias from healthcare utilization patterns, neurodevelopmental concerns and time-dependent exposure classification. METHODS: We conducted a retrospective cohort study using the Cosmos electronic health record database, including 2,560,035 US children with linked birth-parent data and follow-up through age 8 years. To minimize bias related to exposure timing and healthcare utilization, we performed prespecified age-based landmark analyses evaluating the first MMR vaccination administered between 11.5 and 24 months. Adjusted hazard ratios (aHRs) for autism were estimated using Cox proportional hazards models with covariates selected via directed acyclic graphs. A negative control exposure (pneumococcal conjugate vaccine booster administered at 12-15 months) was analyzed to assess residual confounding. RESULTS: In the primary 11.5-24 month landmark cohort, the first MMR vaccination was not associated with increased autism risk (aHR 0.97; 99% confidence interval 0.91-1.03). Across all age-specific landmark cohorts, aHRs remained near the null. The negative control analysis yielded a similarly near-null estimate (aHR 1.01; 99% confidence interval 0.99-1.04), supporting that residual bias is unlikely to explain the findings. CONCLUSIONS: In this large US cohort, age-anchored landmark analyses show no association between MMR vaccination before 24 months and childhood autism. The concordant near-null findings for both MMR and a negative control exposure support that the observed results are unlikely to be explained by residual confounding. These findings highlight the importance of age-specific analytic approaches in evaluating vaccine safety using observational data.

title: In silico clinical trials of BiTE expression by oncolytic viruses reveal the impact of patient heterogeneity on dosage protocol.
abstract: Immunotherapies have become a transformative therapeutic strategy for many cancer types in recent years. Bispecific T-cell engagers (BiTEs) are one promising immunotherapy that enhances cellular antitumour immunity by redirecting T cells towards cancer cells. Recent evidence suggests that BiTE efficacy can be augmented by encoding BiTEs in oncolytic measles virus vectors (MV-BiTE). Infection of cancer cells with MV-BiTE causes the local production of BiTEs and has shown safety and efficacy in murine tumour models. However, whether the observed efficacy of this treatment will translate to a heterogeneous human population is unknown. In this work, we generate an in silico clinical trial of MV-BiTE therapy using a system of ordinary differential equations. We capture potential heterogeneity of individual patients using variability in in vivo tumour volume and change in baseline (%) measurements from a Phase II clinical trial. In lieu of human MV-BiTE data, we use the oncolytic virus talimogene laherparepvec (T-VEC) as a surrogate oncolytic virus carrying an immunostimulatory payload. Our predictions imply that the main drivers of heterogeneity are the underlying effector T cell killing rate and BiTE pharmacokinetics. Furthermore, we find that if individuals are classified as non-responders to the Phase II T-VEC clinical protocol, they may respond to more frequent administration of lower dosages. This work highlights how in silico clinical trials can provide predictions for novel therapeutics to generate hypotheses and guide the design of treatment schedules for clinical translation.

abstract_zh: 近年来,免疫疗法已成为许多癌症类型的变革性治疗策略。双特异性 T 细胞接合剂 (BiTE) 是一种有前景的免疫疗法,可通过将 T 细胞重新导向癌细胞来增强细胞抗肿瘤免疫力。最近的证据表明,通过在溶瘤 麻疹病毒 媒介 (MV-BiTE) 中编码 BiTE 可以增强 BiTE 功效。用 MV-BiTE 感染癌细胞会导致 BiTE 的局部产生,并在小鼠肿瘤模型中显示出安全性和有效性。然而,观察到的 治疗 功效是否会转化为异质人群尚不清楚。在这项工作中,我们使用常微分方程组进行了 MV-BiTE 疗法的计算机临床试验。我们利用 II 期临床试验中体内肿瘤体积的变化和基线 (%) 测量值的变化来捕获个体患者的潜在异质性。我们使用溶瘤病毒 talimogene laherparepvec (T-VEC) 作为携带免疫刺激有效负载的替代溶瘤病毒来代替人类 MV-BiTE 数据。我们的预测表明异质性的主要驱动因素是潜在的效应 T 细胞杀伤率和 BiTE 药代动力学。此外,我们发现,如果个体被归类为对 II 期 T-VEC 临床方案无反应的人,他们可能会对更频繁、更低剂量的给药产生反应。这项工作强调了计算机临床试验如何为新疗法提供预测,以生成假设并指导 治疗 临床转化时间表的设计。

title: Digital Health Communication Collapse: Public Trust, Vaccine Shortages, and the Shutdown of the Surokkha App
abstract: Abstract The introduction of digital health platforms during the COVID-19 pandemic was a significant step toward improving public health governance, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. The Surokkha App was one of the digital tools used in Bangladesh to facilitate the COVID-19 vaccination campaign. It allowed registering appointments, obtaining vaccination certificates, and providing essential health information. However, the tool was discontinued amid reports of a shortage of routine childhood vaccines, including measles, which triggered widespread confusion and mistrust among the public. This study aims to determine how the discontinuation of the digital tool and the shortage of conventional vaccines undermined the government’s ability to communicate effectively and restore confidence. The study examines the crisis through the lens of digital governance, risk communication, and policy implementation. It evaluates policy documents, experts’ opinions, and media reports on the issue to identify the critical areas of concern. The findings reveal that the crisis was caused by inadequate digital health governance, poor contingency planning, and ineffective risk communication, which fueled panic and mistrust. The study concludes that effective digital health governance requires institutional coordination, contingency planning, and effective public communication to build trust and ensure sustainable policy outcomes. The lessons learned can help other developing countries navigate similar challenges and transition from emergency to sustainable health governance effectively.
