title_zh: 数字健康传播崩溃:公众信任、疫苗 短缺以及 Surokkha 应用程序的关闭
source_body_en: Abstract The introduction of digital health platforms during the COVID-19 pandemic was a significant step toward improving public health governance, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. The Surokkha App was one of the digital tools used in Bangladesh to facilitate the COVID-19 vaccination campaign. It allowed registering appointments, obtaining vaccination certificates, and providing essential health information. However, the tool was discontinued amid reports of a shortage of routine childhood vaccines, including measles, which triggered widespread confusion and mistrust among the public. This study aims to determine how the discontinuation of the digital tool and the shortage of conventional vaccines undermined the government’s ability to communicate effectively and restore confidence. The study examines the crisis through the lens of digital governance, risk communication, and policy implementation. It evaluates policy documents, experts’ opinions, and media reports on the issue to identify the critical areas of concern. The findings reveal that the crisis was caused by inadequate digital health governance, poor contingency planning, and ineffective risk communication, which fueled panic and mistrust. The study concludes that effective digital health governance requires institutional coordination, contingency planning, and effective public communication to build trust and ensure sustainable policy outcomes. The lessons learned can help other developing countries navigate similar challenges and transition from emergency to sustainable health governance effectively.
abstract_zh: 摘要:在 COVID-19 大流行期间引入数字健康平台是改善公共卫生治理的重要一步,特别是在低收入和中等收入国家。Surokkha 应用程序是孟加拉国用于促进 COVID-19 疫苗接种 活动的数字工具之一。它允许注册预约、获取 疫苗接种 证书并提供基本的健康信息。然而,由于有报道称儿童常规 疫苗(包括 麻疹)短缺,该工具被终止,这引发了公众的广泛困惑和不信任。本研究旨在确定数字工具的停用和传统 疫苗 的短缺如何削弱政府有效沟通和恢复信心的能力。该研究从数字治理、风险沟通和政策实施的角度审视了这场危机。它评估有关该问题的政策文件、专家意见和媒体报道,以确定值得关注的关键领域。调查结果显示,这场危机是由于数字健康治理不足、应急计划不力以及风险沟通不力造成的,从而加剧了恐慌和不信任。该研究的结论是,有效的数字健康治理需要机构协调、应急计划和有效的公众沟通,以建立信任并确保可持续的政策成果。汲取的经验教训可以帮助其他发展中国家应对类似的挑战,并有效地从紧急情况过渡到可持续的卫生治理。

title: What Is Old Is New Again: Tips and Tricks for Recognizing and Treating Vaccine-Preventable Diseases of Childhood Presenting to the Emergency Department.
abstract: Across the globe, there has been a resurgence in vaccine-preventable diseases reflecting declining immunity, vaccine hesitancy and gaps in vaccine coverage. Vaccination was seen as one of the most successful public health interventions of the 20th century-as a consequence, many vaccine-preventable diseases such as measles and diphtheria were relegated to textbooks. With the re-emergence of vaccine-preventable diseases (VPDs), it is an urgent priority to equip emergency physicians with the knowledge to rapidly identify and manage potential cases and strengthen public health measures to curb transmission.

title: Childhood immunisation coverage in rural and a tribal settings in southern India and assessing effect of the Covid19 pandemic
abstract: ABSTRACT Purpose Childhood immunisation witnessed reduced coverage and delays globally during the Covid19 pandemic. This study aimed to identify gaps in routine childhood immunisation in southern India and the effect of the pandemic in censused rural and tribal populations. Methods This study was conducted between August and September 2021 in a hard-to-reach tribal block (Jawadhu Hills) and rural (Timiri) block in Tamil Nadu. The proportion of full immunisation coverage (FIC), age-appropriate coverage and vaccination delays were calculated in the pre-pandemic (prior to March 2020) and pandemic (lockdown) period. Results Among 2746 children (aged <30 months, with immunisation cards available) surveyed in these populations, overall FIC among children between 12-23 months of age was 50.8% (95%CI: 46.6-55.0) in Jawadhu and 83.7%; (81.1-86.2) in Timiri. In Jawadhu, coverage of oral polio vaccine3 (OPV3) decreased from 78.3% (73.4-82.6) pre-pandemic to 70.0% (66.6-73.2) during the pandemic; inactivated polio vaccine2 (IPV2) from 76.9% (72.1-81.2) to 69.1% (65.5-72.4); Pentavalent3 from 78.0% (73.1-82.4) to 70.2% (66.8-73.5); and Measles containing vaccine1 (MCV1) from 74.6% (67.6-80.8) to 56.7% (53.3-60.1). In Timiri, only MCV1 coverage decreased from 92.9% (88.7-95.9) to 85.4% (83.3-87.3). Factors associated with not receiving MCV1 included due date of vaccination falling during the pandemic lock downs, higher birth order, younger and less educated parents, and residing in the tribal block. Conclusion This study highlighted differences in routine childhood immunisation vaccine coverage and impact of the pandemic in a geographically remote tribal block in contrast to a more accessible, rural block. Resilient health systems are essential to ensure sustainability in gains in vaccination coverage, especially in remote areas, and should be part of pandemic preparedness.

analysis.scope_and_question: This review examines childhood immunisation coverage in rural and tribal settings in southern India, specifically assessing the impact of the Covid-19 pandemic on routine vaccination services.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: A cross-sectional study conducted between August and September 2021 in two blocks: Jawadhu Hills (tribal) and Timiri (rural) in Tamil Nadu, involving 2746 children under 30 months with available immunisation cards.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: Full immunisation coverage (FIC) was significantly lower in the tribal block (50.8%) compared to the rural block (83.7%). The pandemic led to decreased coverage for multiple vaccines in the tribal area, with MCV1 dropping from 74.6% to 56.7%, while only MCV1 decreased in the rural area (92.9% to 85.4%).
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The study highlights disparities between tribal and rural populations but does not address long-term consequences of vaccination delays or explore potential solutions for remote areas beyond suggesting resilient health systems.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: Resilient health systems are essential to maintain vaccination coverage gains, particularly in remote areas, and should be integrated into pandemic preparedness strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated childhood immunisation coverage in rural and tribal populations in southern India during the Covid-19 pandemic. Findings revealed significant disparities between tribal (50.8% FIC) and rural (83.7% FIC) settings, with the tribal area experiencing substantial declines in multiple vaccine coverages during the pandemic. The research underscores the need for resilient health systems to sustain vaccination progress in remote areas and emphasizes the importance of pandemic preparedness for routine immunisation services.

abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 在新冠病毒大流行期间,全球儿童免疫接种覆盖率下降且出现延误。这项研究旨在查明印度南部儿童常规免疫接种方面的差距以及该流行病对人口普查的农村和部落人口的影响。方法 这项研究于 2021 年 8 月至 9 月期间在泰米尔纳德邦一个难以到达的部落街区(贾瓦杜山)和农村街区(蒂米里)进行。完全免疫覆盖率(FIC)、适龄覆盖率和疫苗接种延迟的比例是在大流行前(2020年3月之前)和大流行(封锁)期间计算的。结果 在这些人群中接受调查的 2746 名儿童(年龄 <30 月龄,有免疫卡)中,12-23 月龄儿童的总体 FIC 在贾瓦杜为 50.8%(95%CI:46.6-55.0),在贾瓦杜为 83.7%;(81.1-86.2)在蒂米里。在贾瓦杜,口服脊髓灰质炎疫苗3 (OPV3) 的覆盖率从大流行前的 78.3% (73.4-82.6) 下降到大流行期间的 70.0% (66.6-73.2);灭活脊髓灰质炎疫苗2(IPV2)从76.9%(72.1-81.2)降至69.1%(65.5-72.4);五价3从 78.0% (73.1-82.4) 降至 70.2% (66.8-73.5);和麻疹含有疫苗1(MCV1)从74.6%(67.6-80.8)到56.7%(53.3-60.1)。在 Timiri,仅 MCV1 覆盖率从 92.9% (88.7-95.9) 下降至 85.4% (83.3-87.3)。与未接受 MCV1 相关的因素包括 疫苗接种 的预产期在大流行封锁期间下降、出生顺序较高、父母年轻且受教育程度较低以及居住在部落街区。结论 本研究强调了地理偏远部落地区与更容易到达的农村地区常规儿童免疫 疫苗 覆盖率和大流行影响的差异。具有复原力的卫生系统对于确保 疫苗接种 覆盖范围收益的可持续性至关重要,特别是在偏远地区,并且应该成为大流行病防范的一部分。

title: Parents’ role as advocates for and against childhood vaccination: Findings from a nationally representative survey
abstract: INTRODUCTION: In 2025, the US recorded the highest number of measles cases in 25 years, signaling an urgent need for renewed attention to increasing childhood vaccination coverage. To identify future intervention partners, we sought to understand parents' role in advocating for and against childhood vaccines. METHODS: A nationally representative sample of 1,315 parents of children ages 9-12 years participated in our online survey about vaccine advocacy behaviors in 2025. Separate weighted logistic regression models identified correlates of encouraging or discouraging other parents from getting routine vaccines for their children. RESULTS: Over one-third of parents reported encouraging routine vaccines sometimes or more often (36%), while about one-tenth reported discouraging vaccines (12%). These estimates include a small proportion of parents (6%) who reported both behaviors. Parents with higher confidence in the importance of vaccines for their child's health were more likely to be encouragers and less likely to be discouragers (both p < .05). Encouragers (n = 477) most often advocated for measles (50%) or seasonal flu vaccines (44%). These parents most often engaged family members and close friends, using strategies such as sharing vaccine experiences (47%), information about vaccine effectiveness (38%), and advice or opinions about vaccines (35%). Discouragers (n = 151) most often advocated against Covid-19 (53%) or seasonal flu vaccines (41%), with relatively few focusing on measles vaccine (10%). Discouragers engaged similar audiences and strategies as encouragers. CONCLUSION: Findings of our nationally representative study suggest that parents who encourage routine vaccination far outnumber those who discourage it. Given that encouragers often advocate for measles vaccine, future efforts to increase vaccination coverage should consider ways to partner with parent advocates to stem the alarming resurgence of this disease.

title_zh: 父母作为儿童支持者和反对者的角色 疫苗接种:全国代表性调查的结果
source_body_en: INTRODUCTION: In 2025, the US recorded the highest number of measles cases in 25 years, signaling an urgent need for renewed attention to increasing childhood vaccination coverage. To identify future intervention partners, we sought to understand parents' role in advocating for and against childhood vaccines. METHODS: A nationally representative sample of 1,315 parents of children ages 9-12 years participated in our online survey about vaccine advocacy behaviors in 2025. Separate weighted logistic regression models identified correlates of encouraging or discouraging other parents from getting routine vaccines for their children. RESULTS: Over one-third of parents reported encouraging routine vaccines sometimes or more often (36%), while about one-tenth reported discouraging vaccines (12%). These estimates include a small proportion of parents (6%) who reported both behaviors. Parents with higher confidence in the importance of vaccines for their child's health were more likely to be encouragers and less likely to be discouragers (both p < .05). Encouragers (n = 477) most often advocated for measles (50%) or seasonal flu vaccines (44%). These parents most often engaged family members and close friends, using strategies such as sharing vaccine experiences (47%), information about vaccine effectiveness (38%), and advice or opinions about vaccines (35%). Discouragers (n = 151) most often advocated against Covid-19 (53%) or seasonal flu vaccines (41%), with relatively few focusing on measles vaccine (10%). Discouragers engaged similar audiences and strategies as encouragers. CONCLUSION: Findings of our nationally representative study suggest that parents who encourage routine vaccination far outnumber those who discourage it. Given that encouragers often advocate for measles vaccine, future efforts to increase vaccination coverage should consider ways to partner with parent advocates to stem the alarming resurgence of this disease.

title: Analysis of Communicable Disease Trends in Children: Babylon Governorate, Iraq from 2022 to 2024
abstract: Background: Infectious diseases are a great challenge to the health of children globally. This paper provides an epidemiological scenario and patterns of these diseases among children in the Hilla Babylon Governorate, Iraq, and specifically, the re-emergence of meals. Methods: The retrospective study was carried out on 7851 medical records of children aged below 15 years between the period of January 1, 2022 and December 31, 2024. The registry of Babylon Maternity and Children Hospital was used to extract data. Data were analyzed in terms of trends and distributions by age, sex and time using descriptive statistics and inferential tests. Results: Droplet and airborne mode of infection were responsible of a huge percentage (89.1, n=6998). The most common one was pneumonia (59.3, n=4659), and then measles (21.0, n=1651). The dramatic resurgence of measles was recorded, and in 2022, there were zero cases, and in 2023, the rates were 344 and in 2024, 1,307. Foodborne infections 10.1% (n=795) were mainly hepatitis A (98.4% of foodborne infections). Significant differences in the age and sex distributions of particular diseases were found to be statistically significant. Younger children (years) had more pneumonia, pertussis, and viral meningitis whereas older children (5-9 years) had Hepatitis A. Pneumonia and viral meningitis had a high male predominance whereas pertussis was more prevalent in females. Conclusion: Respiratory-borne diseases and especially pneumonia and measles have the greatest burden of communicable disease among children in this region. The disastrous revival of measles points to the existence of severe gaps in immunization coverage and preparedness to the outbreaks. The interventions in the field of public health should be focused on the reinforcement of a routine and catch-up vaccination campaign, the improvement of respiratory infections control, and the improvement of sanitation and hygiene measures directed at high-risk age groups.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Infectious diseases pose a major health challenge for children globally, and the study aimed to characterize the epidemiological patterns and burden of these diseases among children in Babylon Governorate, Iraq, with a focus on the re-emergence of measles.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective study was conducted using 7,851 medical records of children aged below 15 years from the Babylon Maternity and Children Hospital registry between January 1, 2022, and December 31, 2024.
analysis.methods: Data were extracted from hospital records and analyzed using descriptive statistics and inferential tests to assess trends and distributions by age, sex, and time.
analysis.main_results: Measles cases dramatically resurged from zero in 2022 to 344 in 2023 and 1,307 in 2024, with pneumonia being the most common disease (59.3%, n=4,659) followed by measles (21.0%, n=1,651).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the resurgence of measles as indicating severe gaps in immunization coverage and outbreak preparedness in the region.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the urgent need to strengthen routine and catch-up vaccination campaigns, improve control of respiratory infections, and enhance sanitation and hygiene measures for high-risk age groups.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective design, reliance on a single hospital registry, and lack of detailed etiological confirmation for reported diseases, which may affect the accuracy and generalizability of the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 7,851 medical records from children under 15 years in Babylon Governorate, Iraq, between 2022 and 2024 to assess trends in communicable diseases. Measles cases surged from zero in 2022 to 1,307 in 2024, with pneumonia being the most prevalent condition. The authors attribute the measles resurgence to gaps in immunization coverage and call for strengthened vaccination campaigns, improved respiratory infection control, and enhanced hygiene measures. However, the study's retrospective design, single-center data source, and absence of detailed etiological confirmation limit the robustness and generalizability of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 传染病对全球儿童构成重大健康挑战,该研究旨在描述伊拉克巴比伦省儿童中这些疾病的流行病学模式和负担,重点关注 麻疹 的重新出现。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项回顾性研究使用了巴比伦妇幼医院登记处 2022 年 1 月 1 日至 2024 年 12 月 31 日期间 7,851 份 15 岁以下儿童的医疗记录。
elements_zh.methods: 从医院记录中提取数据,并使用描述性统计和推理测试进行分析,以评估按年龄、性别和时间划分的趋势和分布。
elements_zh.main_results: 麻疹 病例从 2022 年的零急剧增加到 2023 年的 344 例和 2024 年的 1,307 例,其中肺炎是最常见的疾病(59.3%,n=4,659),其次是 麻疹(21.0%,n=1,651)。

title_zh: 2022年至2024年伊拉克巴比伦省儿童传染病趋势分析
source_body_en: Background: Infectious diseases are a great challenge to the health of children globally. This paper provides an epidemiological scenario and patterns of these diseases among children in the Hilla Babylon Governorate, Iraq, and specifically, the re-emergence of meals. Methods: The retrospective study was carried out on 7851 medical records of children aged below 15 years between the period of January 1, 2022 and December 31, 2024. The registry of Babylon Maternity and Children Hospital was used to extract data. Data were analyzed in terms of trends and distributions by age, sex and time using descriptive statistics and inferential tests. Results: Droplet and airborne mode of infection were responsible of a huge percentage (89.1, n=6998). The most common one was pneumonia (59.3, n=4659), and then measles (21.0, n=1651). The dramatic resurgence of measles was recorded, and in 2022, there were zero cases, and in 2023, the rates were 344 and in 2024, 1,307. Foodborne infections 10.1% (n=795) were mainly hepatitis A (98.4% of foodborne infections). Significant differences in the age and sex distributions of particular diseases were found to be statistically significant. Younger children (years) had more pneumonia, pertussis, and viral meningitis whereas older children (5-9 years) had Hepatitis A. Pneumonia and viral meningitis had a high male predominance whereas pertussis was more prevalent in females. Conclusion: Respiratory-borne diseases and especially pneumonia and measles have the greatest burden of communicable disease among children in this region. The disastrous revival of measles points to the existence of severe gaps in immunization coverage and preparedness to the outbreaks. The interventions in the field of public health should be focused on the reinforcement of a routine and catch-up vaccination campaign, the improvement of respiratory infections control, and the improvement of sanitation and hygiene measures directed at high-risk age groups.
abstract_zh: 背景:传染病是对全球儿童健康的巨大挑战。本文提供了伊拉克希拉巴比伦省儿童中这些疾病的流行病学情况和模式,特别是膳食的重新出现。方法:对2022年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间7851份15岁以下儿童病历进行回顾性研究,采用巴比伦妇幼医院病历进行提取。使用描述性统计和推理检验对数据进行按年龄、性别和时间的趋势和分布分析。结果:飞沫和空气传播的感染方式占很大比例(89.1,n=6998)。最常见的是肺炎(59.3,n=4659),然后是 麻疹(21.0,n=1651)。麻疹 的急剧复苏被记录下来,2022 年为零病例,2023 年为 344 例,2024 年为 1,307 例。食源性感染 10.1% (n=795) 主要是甲型肝炎 (98.4% 食源性感染)。发现特定疾病的年龄和性别分布存在显着差异,具有统计学意义。年龄较小的儿童(岁)更多患有肺炎、百日咳和病毒性脑膜炎,而年龄较大的儿童(5-9 岁)则患有甲型肝炎。肺炎和病毒性脑膜炎以男性为主,而百日咳在女性中更为常见。结论:呼吸道传播疾病,特别是肺炎和麻疹是该地区儿童传染病负担最大的疾病。麻疹 的灾难性复活表明,麻疹 的免疫覆盖率和准备工作中存在严重差距。公共卫生领域的干预措施应重点加强常规和追赶的疫苗接种运动,改善呼吸道感染控制,改善针对高危人群的环境卫生和个人卫生措施。

title: Prepared or at-risk? Evaluating live viral vaccine coverage and vaccine immunogenicity before pediatric solid organ transplantation
abstract: Pediatric solid organ transplant recipients are at high risk for complications from vaccine-preventable diseases, yet pre-transplant vaccination coverage is often inconsistent. We conducted a retrospective cohort study of 421 pediatric transplant recipients between 2018 and 2024 to evaluate vaccination status and serologic immunity for varicella and measles at the time of initial evaluation, listing, and transplantation. At the time of transplant, 19.2% of patients for varicella and 21.6% for measles were under-vaccinated, with infants having the highest rates of incomplete vaccination. A portion of patients (7.1% for varicella, 8.6% for measles) transitioned from full to incomplete vaccination status during the pre-transplant period, a change associated with a shorter time from evaluation to listing. Kidney recipients had the highest completed vaccination rates (>94%), whereas rates for liver and heart recipients were substantially lower (58%–72%). Among fully vaccinated patients, seronegativity was observed for varicella (23.6%) and measles (13.0%). In conclusion, many pediatric transplant candidates, particularly infants and those awaiting liver or heart transplant, are incompletely vaccinated. A dynamic change in vaccination status from evaluation to transplant highlights an urgent need for continuous monitoring and improved strategies to protect these vulnerable children.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2018 年至 2024 年间 421 名儿科移植受者进行了一项回顾性 队列研究 研究,以评估 疫苗接种 在初始评估、上市和移植时对水痘和 麻疹 的状态和血清学免疫。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究通过回顾性数据收集和血清学检测评估了水痘和 麻疹 的 疫苗接种 状态和血清学免疫。它评估了从评估到移植期间 疫苗接种 状态的变化,并将这些变化与评估和列出之间的时间间隔联系起来。
elements_zh.main_results: 在移植时,21.6% 的 麻疹 患者疫苗接种不足,其中婴儿的 麻疹 不完全接种率最高。一部分患者(麻疹 为 8.6%)在移植前从完全 麻疹 状态转变为不完全 疫苗接种 状态,这一变化与从评估到列出的时间较短有关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了 麻疹 移植前 疫苗接种 覆盖范围的不一致以及 疫苗接种 状态变化的动态性质,特别是在婴儿和等待肝脏或心脏移植的患者中。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果强调需要改进 疫苗接种 策略和持续监测,以保护儿科移植候选者免受 疫苗 可预防疾病(如 麻疹)的影响。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性设计和潜在的数据缺失而受到限制。证据是中等的,因为它是基于观察数据而不是实验或前瞻性方法。

title: Tissue-directed maintenance of human B-cell memory after vaccination and infection 2260241
abstract: Abstract Introduction Vaccines differ in their efficacy and durability of protection. Clinical titer studies show that some, e.g. measles, confer lifelong immunity, while others wane within months or years. The memory B cells (MBCs) that sustain these responses reside mainly in lymphoid tissues, but it remains unclear whether these compartments maintain distinct subsets, how they contribute to vaccine immunity, and how they vary with age or antigen. Methods We profiled four ag-specific MBC populations, specific for childhood vaccines measles and tetanus and ubiquitous viruses SARS-CoV-2 and H1N1 influenza, across paired blood, spleen, lymph nodes, and bone marrow, by flow cytometry and paired single-cell RNA and B-cell receptor (BCR) sequencing. Results MBC isotype, subset, and phenotype differed markedly between tissue sites, specificity, and age. Lymph nodes were reservoirs for classical IgG+ memory with high expression of the residency marker CD69. In other sites, whereas measles retained a classical phenotype, tetanus MBCs were enriched for non-switched memory. Notably, SARS-CoV-2 and influenza responses were highly switched but, with age, uniquely accumulated hyporesponsive CD27- CD21- atypical memory in the blood, bone marrow, and spleen. RNA sequencing resolved three core MBC subsets enriched in distinct tissues: tissue-adapted classical MBCs in lymph nodes, marginal zone—like MBCs in spleen, and atypical MBCs in bone marrow. All three subsets were represented within ag-specific populations, but their relative proportions were shaped by both tissue and antigen. Clonal and phylogenetic analyses revealed that expanded ag-specific clones, including cells with identical BCRs, spanned multiple subsets, indicating that MBC identity is flexible but primarily shaped by local context rather than lineage. Conclusion This work uncovers functionally distinct tissue reservoirs of vaccine and infection-induced memory and the host and antigen factors that shape them, highlighting new opportunities for vaccine design. Funding Source NIH U19 AI128949, DARPA Topic Categories Lymphocyte Differentiation and Peripheral Maintenance (LYM)

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated tissue-directed maintenance of human B-cell memory after vaccination and infection, focusing on measles, tetanus, SARS-CoV-2, and H1N1 influenza. Researchers found that memory B cell subsets, isotypes, and phenotypes varied significantly by tissue site, antigen specificity, and age. Lymph nodes served as reservoirs for classical IgG+ memory with high CD69 expression, while other sites showed distinct patterns, such as non-switched memory for tetanus and atypical memory for SARS-CoV-2 and influenza with age. RNA sequencing identified three core MBC subsets enriched in different tissues, and clonal analyses revealed that expanded antigen-specific clones spanned multiple subsets, indicating flexible identity shaped by local context. The findings highlight functionally distinct tissue reservoirs and their shaping factors, offering new insights for vaccine design.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了配对血液、脾脏、淋巴结和骨髓样本中儿童 疫苗(麻疹 和破伤风)和普遍存在的病毒(SARS-CoV-2 和 H1N1 流感)的抗原特异性 MBC 群体。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用流式细胞术和配对单细胞 RNA 和 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 测序来分析 MBC 群体,其中 RNA 测序解析了不同组织中富集的三个核心 MBC 亚群。
elements_zh.main_results: MBC 同种型、亚型和表型在组织部位、特异性和年龄之间存在显着差异;淋巴结为 储存宿主,代表经典 IgG+ 记忆,CD69 高表达;扩展的抗原特异性克隆跨越多个子集,表明由当地环境决定的灵活的 MBC 身份。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为揭示了 疫苗 的功能上不同的组织 储存宿主 和感染诱导的记忆,由 宿主 和抗原因子塑造,突出了 疫苗 设计的新机会。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过揭示组织特异性记忆 B 细胞维持如何随抗原和年龄而变化,为 疫苗 设计提供信息,从而可能指导增强持久免疫力的策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的证据强度很高,因为它使用高级测序全面分析了多种组织和抗原,但其局限性包括超出研究人群和抗原的潜在普遍性。

abstract_zh: 摘要 简介 疫苗 的保护功效和持久性各不相同。临床滴度研究表明,一些,例如麻疹 赋予终生免疫力,而其他免疫力则在数月或数年内减弱。维持这些反应的记忆 B 细胞 (MBC) 主要存在于淋巴组织中,但目前尚不清楚这些区室是否维持不同的子集、它们如何促进 疫苗 免疫、以及它们如何随年龄或抗原而变化。方法 我们通过流式细胞术和配对单细胞 RNA 和 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 测序,对配对血液、脾脏、淋巴结和骨髓中的四种 Ag 特异性 MBC 群体进行了分析,这些群体针对儿童 疫苗 麻疹 和破伤风以及普遍存在的病毒 SARS-CoV-2 和 H1N1 流感。结果 MBC 同种型、亚型和表型在组织部位、特异性和年龄之间存在显着差异。淋巴结为 储存宿主,代表经典 IgG+ 记忆,高表达驻留标记 CD69。在其他位点,虽然 麻疹 保留了经典表型,但破伤风 MBC 的非转换记忆得到了丰富。值得注意的是,SARS-CoV-2 和流感反应高度不同,但随着年龄的增长,血液、骨髓和脾脏中独特地积累了低反应性 CD27-CD21-非典型记忆。RNA测序解析了在不同组织中富集的三个核心MBC亚群:淋巴结中的组织适应经典MBC、脾中的边缘区样MBC和骨髓中的非典型MBC。所有三个亚群都代表抗原特异性群体,但它们的相对比例由组织和抗原决定。克隆和系统发育分析表明,扩大的 Ag 特异性克隆(包括具有相同 BCR 的细胞)跨越多个子集,这表明 MBC 身份是灵活的,但主要由局部环境而不是谱系决定。结论 这项工作揭示了 疫苗 的功能上不同的组织 储存宿主 和感染诱导的记忆以及 宿主 和塑造它们的抗原因子,突出了 疫苗 设计的新机会。资金来源 NIH U19 AI128949、DARPA 主题类别 淋巴细胞分化和外周维护 (LYM)

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了配对血液、脾脏、淋巴结和骨髓样本中儿童 疫苗(麻疹 和破伤风)和普遍存在的病毒(SARS-CoV-2 和 H1N1 流感)的抗原特异性 MBC 群体。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员使用流式细胞术和配对单细胞 RNA 和 B 细胞受体 (BCR) 测序来分析 MBC 群体,其中 RNA 测序解析了不同组织中富集的三个核心 MBC 亚群。
analysis_zh.main_results: MBC 同种型、亚型和表型在组织部位、特异性和年龄之间存在显着差异;淋巴结为 储存宿主,代表经典 IgG+ 记忆,CD69 高表达;扩展的抗原特异性克隆跨越多个子集,表明由当地环境决定的灵活的 MBC 身份。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为揭示了 疫苗 的功能上不同的组织 储存宿主 和感染诱导的记忆,由 宿主 和抗原因子塑造,突出了 疫苗 设计的新机会。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过揭示组织特异性记忆 B 细胞维持如何随抗原和年龄而变化,为 疫苗 设计提供信息,从而可能指导增强持久免疫力的策略。

title: Computational design of immunogenic peptide–ligand conjugates for targeted therapy against Nipah virus infection
abstract: Introduction Nipah virus (NiV) poses a major risk to global public health due to its high infectivity and associated mortality rates. Currently, no licensed vaccines or antiviral medications are available for NiV infection, leaving clinical management limited to supportive care. The viral receptor glycoprotein responsible for binding NiV to host cell receptors (ephrin-B2/B3) represents an ideal therapeutic target. This study proposes a novel peptide-ligand conjugate (PLC) immunotherapeutic approach that exploits pre-existing immune responses in NiV-endemic populations to selectively target and eliminate infected cells. Methods We employed biomolecular modeling ( in silico ) to establish binding affinities and perform docking studies using a compound library obtained from the MolProphet database. A non-cleavable oxime linker was selected to enhance physical stability and ensure robust conjugation between ligand and peptide components. The peptide was engineered to contain immunogenic minimal epitope regions derived from measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines, selected based on their high immunization rates and long-lived memory responses in individuals residing in NiV-endemic areas. Results The PLC design demonstrated selective binding capacity to a transmembrane protein present on NiV-infected cells. The oxime linker provided enhanced stability, and the peptide epitope design successfully incorporated regions associated with established long-term immunity. Discussion This PLC system represents a promising framework for antiviral therapeutic development by harnessing pre-existing immune recognition to promote selective clearance of NiV-infected cells. The findings highlight critical structural components and functional roles of PLCs in therapeutic development, including drug target screening and rational design strategies for enhancing targeting specificity and molecular stability. Future work should focus on experimental validation of the computational predictions and in vitro / in vivo efficacy studies.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents a computational approach to design immunogenic peptide–ligand conjugates (PLCs) for targeted therapy against Nipah virus infection. The research is motivated by the lack of licensed vaccines or antiviral medications for NiV, which poses a significant public health risk. The methods involve in silico modeling to identify binding affinities and docking studies, alongside engineering peptides with epitopes from measles, mumps, and rubella vaccines, which are known for their high immunization rates and long-lived memory responses. The main result is the demonstration of selective binding of the PLC to a transmembrane protein on NiV-infected cells. The authors interpret this as a promising framework for antiviral therapy, utilizing pre-existing immune recognition to target infected cells. The findings highlight the potential of PLCs in therapeutic development, particularly in drug target screening and rational design strategies. However, the study is limited to computational design and lacks experimental validation, which moderates the confidence in the results.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在开发一种新型免疫治疗方法来对抗尼帕病毒感染,因为它的高传染性和相关的 死亡率 率对全球公共卫生构成重大风险。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用计算方法设计肽-配体缀合物(PLC),用于针对尼帕病毒感染的靶向治疗,重点关注可以利用预先存在的 免疫应答 的 NiV 流行人群。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用生物分子模型(计算机)来建立结合亲和力,并与 MolProphet 数据库中的化合物库进行对接研究。他们还对肽进行了改造,使其包含来自 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 疫苗 的免疫原性表位,这些表位是根据其高免疫率和长效记忆反应而选择的。
elements_zh.main_results: PLC 设计证明了对尼帕病毒感染细胞上存在的跨膜蛋白的选择性结合能力。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将这些发现解释为 抗病毒药物 治疗开发的一个有前途的框架,利用预先存在的免疫识别来促进尼帕病毒感染细胞的选择性清除。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 PLC 在治疗开发中的结构成分和功能作用提供了重要的见解,这可以为未来增强 抗病毒药物 治疗 的靶向特异性和分子稳定性的策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于计算设计,缺乏实验验证,这使得证据强度降至中等。

title: Vaccine Misconceptions and Healthcare Workers 2306364
abstract: Abstract Introduction Despite vaccination being one of the most effective public-health interventions, vaccine confidence has recently declined. Widespread misinformation and reduced trust in public health agencies have created challenges for those in healthcare. Perceived gaps in federal communication further complicate clinical and educational information-seeking. As institutional credibility is questioned, healthcare professionals rely on fragmented online sources that amplify uncertainty and misinformation. Polling data show that parents report trusting non-medical influencers (i.e. Joe Rogan, RFK Jr., and the Children’s Defense Fund) for critical children’s health information. The politicization of science underscores the urgent need to strengthen immunology and vaccine literacy education across clinical training and healthcare professionals. Methods We conducted an IRB-approved, anonymous assessment (n = 7711) across those employed in healthcare/science (HCW/S) and non-healthcare workers (NHCW). Results Results showed that although HCW/S generally held more accurate vaccine perceptions than NHCW, misconceptions remained common. For the statement, “There is evidence that the mercury in the measles vaccine can cause autism”, HCW had a lower weighted mean score (1.97 vs. 2.35; n = 7711; p = 0.05). However, 32% still selected strongly agree, agree, or neither agree nor disagree, despite this statement being factually incorrect. Similar analyses were observed across other statements, including 33% of HCW believing the influenza vaccine can cause influenza. Conclusion Vaccine education rooted in core immunologic concepts and communication literacy is critical amid declining trust in traditional public-health authorities. Strengthening immunology curricula, CMEs, CEUs, role playing, discussions, etc. are critical to ensure that healthcare professionals can critically evaluate evidence, identify reliable sources, and counter misinformation to sustain a scientifically informed workforce. Funding Source n/a Topic Categories Immunology Education and Communication (EDU)

title: Karakterisasi transformasi kultur sel ginjal monyet ekor panjang secara molekuler
abstract: Satwa primata memiliki peran penting dalam penelitian biomedis karena memiliki kemiripan genetik dan fisiologis yang erat dengan manusia. Sel ginjal yang ditransformasi bersumber dari monyet ekor panjang (Mf) asal Indonesia telah berhasil dikembangkan untuk tujuan menjadi sel model in vitro dan pengembangan riset vaksin. Sel lestari dengan kualitas yang baik harus memiliki karakteristik yang sama dengan sel induknya. Karakterisasi sel ginjal transformasi Mf belum pernah dilakukan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk karakterisasi molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang dilakukan transformasi dengan mengkarakterisasi keberadaan gen reseptor virus, gen penekan tumor, dan gen proliferasi. Analisis dilakukan terhadap gen CD46 dan CD155 sebagai reseptor virus measles dan polio, gen endosialin, CD24, dan vWF sebagai penanda morfologi sel (fibroblast, epitel, dan endotel), serta gen PCNA dan P53 sebagai penanda proliferasi dan penekan tumor. Keberadaan gen dianalisis melalui teknik PCR. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa gen target dalam studi ini (CD46, CD155, CD24, endosialin, vWF, PCNA, dan P53) berhasil teridentifikasi dalam sel ginjal Mf transformasi, sel Vero dan sel ginjal Mf normal. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa secara molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang ditransformasi menunjukkan karakteristik secara molekuler yang sama dengan sel ginjal Mf normal dan berpotensi sebagai model sel untuk penelitian biomedis sebagai sediaan in vitro untuk pengembangan vaksin.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need for in vitro cell models derived from non-human primates that closely resemble human cells for biomedical research, particularly vaccine development. It highlights the gap in molecular characterization of transformed kidney cells from long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis) from Indonesia.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research characterized transformed kidney cells from long-tailed macaques (Mf) using molecular techniques. The study focused on cells sourced from Indonesian macaques and compared transformed cells with normal kidney cells and Vero cells.
analysis.methods: The presence of target genes was analyzed using PCR to detect measles virus receptors (CD46 and CD155), cell morphology markers (endosialin, CD24, and vWF), and proliferation and tumor suppressor markers (PCNA and P53).
analysis.main_results: All target genes (CD46, CD155, CD24, endosialin, vWF, PCNA, and P53) were successfully identified in the transformed Mf kidney cells, normal Mf kidney cells, and Vero cells.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the findings as evidence that transformed Mf kidney cells retain molecular characteristics similar to normal Mf kidney cells, supporting their potential use as in vitro models for biomedical research and vaccine development. This characterization had not been previously performed.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study suggests that transformed Mf kidney cells could serve as reliable in vitro models for measles virus research and vaccine development, potentially improving preclinical testing and reducing reliance on human-derived cells.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to molecular characterization via PCR and does not include functional assays or direct measles virus infection studies, which weakens the strength of the conclusions. The study is based solely on abstract-level evidence, further reducing confidence.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize transformed kidney cells from long-tailed macaques (Macaca fascicularis) at the molecular level to assess their suitability as in vitro models for biomedical research, particularly vaccine development. Using PCR, the authors detected key genes including measles virus receptors (CD46 and CD155), cell morphology markers (endosialin, CD24, vWF), and proliferation and tumor suppressor markers (PCNA and P53). All target genes were identified in transformed Mf kidney cells, normal Mf kidney cells, and Vero cells, suggesting molecular similarity between transformed and normal cells. The authors conclude that transformed Mf kidney cells could serve as reliable in vitro models for measles virus research and vaccine development. However, the study is limited to molecular characterization without functional validation or direct measles virus infection assays, and the evidence is derived solely from the abstract, reducing the strength of the findings.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用分子技术对长尾猕猴 (Mf) 的转化肾细胞进行了表征。该研究的重点是来自印度尼西亚猕猴的细胞,并将转化细胞与正常肾细胞和 Vero 细胞进行比较。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 PCR 分析靶基因的存在,以检测 麻疹病毒 受体(CD46 和 CD155)、细胞形态标记物(内皮唾液酸蛋白、CD24 和 vWF)以及增殖和肿瘤抑制标记物(PCNA 和 P53)。
elements_zh.main_results: 在转化的 Mf 肾细胞、正常 Mf 肾细胞和 Vero 细胞中成功鉴定了所有靶基因(CD46、CD155、CD24、内皮唾液酸蛋白、vWF、PCNA 和 P53)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明转化的 Mf 肾细胞保留了与正常 Mf 肾细胞相似的分子特征,支持它们作为生物医学研究和 疫苗 开发的体外模型的潜在用途。以前没有进行过这种表征。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,转化的 Mf 肾细胞可以作为 麻疹病毒 研究和 疫苗 开发的可靠体外模型,有可能改善临床前测试并减少对人源细胞的依赖。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于通过 PCR 进行的分子表征,不包括功能测定或直接的 麻疹病毒 感染研究,这削弱了结论的强度。该研究仅基于抽象级别的证据,进一步降低了可信度。

analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to molecular characterization via PCR and does not include functional assays or direct measles virus infection studies, which weakens the strength of the conclusions. The study is based solely on abstract-level evidence, further reducing confidence.

title_zh: 文化转型与文化转型
source_body_en: Satwa primata memiliki peran penting dalam penelitian biomedis karena memiliki kemiripan genetik dan fisiologis yang erat dengan manusia. Sel ginjal yang ditransformasi bersumber dari monyet ekor panjang (Mf) asal Indonesia telah berhasil dikembangkan untuk tujuan menjadi sel model in vitro dan pengembangan riset vaksin. Sel lestari dengan kualitas yang baik harus memiliki karakteristik yang sama dengan sel induknya. Karakterisasi sel ginjal transformasi Mf belum pernah dilakukan. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk karakterisasi molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang dilakukan transformasi dengan mengkarakterisasi keberadaan gen reseptor virus, gen penekan tumor, dan gen proliferasi. Analisis dilakukan terhadap gen CD46 dan CD155 sebagai reseptor virus measles dan polio, gen endosialin, CD24, dan vWF sebagai penanda morfologi sel (fibroblast, epitel, dan endotel), serta gen PCNA dan P53 sebagai penanda proliferasi dan penekan tumor. Keberadaan gen dianalisis melalui teknik PCR. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa gen target dalam studi ini (CD46, CD155, CD24, endosialin, vWF, PCNA, dan P53) berhasil teridentifikasi dalam sel ginjal Mf transformasi, sel Vero dan sel ginjal Mf normal. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa secara molekuler sel ginjal Mf yang ditransformasi menunjukkan karakteristik secara molekuler yang sama dengan sel ginjal Mf normal dan berpotensi sebagai model sel untuk penelitian biomedis sebagai sediaan in vitro untuk pengembangan vaksin.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了生物医学研究(特别是 疫苗 开发)对源自非人类灵长类动物的体外细胞模型的需求,这些模型与人类细胞非常相似。它强调了印度尼西亚长尾猕猴(Macaca fasciculis)转化肾细胞分子特征方面的差距。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用分子技术对长尾猕猴 (Mf) 的转化肾细胞进行了表征。该研究的重点是来自印度尼西亚猕猴的细胞,并将转化细胞与正常肾细胞和 Vero 细胞进行比较。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 PCR 分析靶基因的存在,以检测 麻疹病毒 受体(CD46 和 CD155)、细胞形态标记物(内皮唾液酸蛋白、CD24 和 vWF)以及增殖和肿瘤抑制标记物(PCNA 和 P53)。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在转化的 Mf 肾细胞、正常 Mf 肾细胞和 Vero 细胞中成功鉴定了所有靶基因(CD46、CD155、CD24、内皮唾液酸蛋白、vWF、PCNA 和 P53)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为证据,表明转化的 Mf 肾细胞保留了与正常 Mf 肾细胞相似的分子特征,支持它们作为生物医学研究和 疫苗 开发的体外模型的潜在用途。以前没有进行过这种表征。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究表明,转化的 Mf 肾细胞可以作为 麻疹病毒 研究和 疫苗 开发的可靠体外模型,有可能改善临床前测试并减少对人源细胞的依赖。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于通过 PCR 进行的分子表征,不包括功能测定或直接的 麻疹病毒 感染研究,这削弱了结论的强度。该研究仅基于抽象级别的证据,进一步降低了可信度。

title_original: Hematologic Changes Associated With Measles Infection: A Retrospective Chart Review.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines hematologic changes associated with measles virus infection in humans, focusing on the pathogen Measles morbillivirus (Morbillivirus hominis), the disease measles, and its severe complication subacute sclerosing panencephalitis. The central question addresses the hematologic manifestations and laboratory abnormalities observed during measles infection.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The evidence base consists of a retrospective chart review study design analyzing hematologic parameters in measles-infected patients. The review method includes retrospective chart extraction and analysis of laboratory data from clinical records, with no explicit mention of systematic search strategies, eligibility criteria beyond measles diagnosis, or meta-analytic processes.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review identifies consistent hematologic abnormalities associated with measles infection, including lymphopenia and thrombocytopenia, as key findings supported by retrospective clinical data. These changes are highlighted as characteristic laboratory features during acute measles episodes.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes limited data on long-term hematologic recovery post-measles infection and the absence of standardized protocols for hematologic monitoring in measles cases. There is also a lack of comparative data across different measles genotypes (e.g., B3, D8) regarding hematologic severity.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for prospective studies to validate hematologic markers as prognostic indicators in measles and to establish standardized laboratory monitoring guidelines for infected patients. Additionally, it suggests investigating genotype-specific hematologic differences to refine clinical management.

analysis.summary_en: This review synthesizes evidence from a retrospective chart review on hematologic changes during measles virus infection in humans. It identifies consistent findings of lymphopenia and thrombocytopenia as characteristic laboratory abnormalities in acute measles episodes. The evidence base relies on retrospective clinical data extraction without systematic search methods or meta-analysis. Key gaps include limited data on long-term recovery and genotype-specific differences, while standardized monitoring protocols remain undeveloped. The review prioritizes prospective validation of hematologic markers for prognosis and the establishment of clinical monitoring guidelines to improve patient management.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述检查了与人类 麻疹病毒 感染相关的血液学变化,重点关注病原体 麻疹 麻疹病毒(人麻疹病毒)、疾病 麻疹 及其严重并发症 亚急性硬化性全脑炎。中心问题涉及 麻疹 感染期间观察到的血液学表现和实验室异常。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 证据基础包括回顾性图表审查研究设计,分析 麻疹 感染患者的血液学参数。审查方法包括从临床记录中提取和分析实验室数据的回顾性图表,没有明确提及系统搜索策略、麻疹 诊断 之外的资格标准或荟萃分析过程。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述确定了与 麻疹 感染相关的一致血液学异常,包括淋巴细胞减少和血小板减少,作为回顾性临床数据支持的关键发现。这些变化被强调为急性 麻疹 发作期间的典型实验室特征。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述指出,关于 麻疹 感染后长期血液学恢复的数据有限,并且缺乏 麻疹 病例血液学监测的标准化方案。不同 麻疹 基因型(例如 B3、D8)之间也缺乏关于血液学严重程度的比较数据。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要进行前瞻性研究来验证血液学标志物作为 麻疹 的预后指标,并为感染患者建立标准化的实验室监测指南。此外,它建议调查基因型特异性血液学差异以完善临床管理。

full_text: Measles, one of the most contagious pathogens known, was declared eliminated in the United States in 2000, yet it has re‐emerged as a growing epidemic threat. Schools now sit at the epicenter of this resurgence. Declining childhood vaccination rates, politicization of immunization policy, and erosion of institutional authority have converged to create conditions where measles can again spread through classrooms and communities. While cases were first reported in Texas in January 2025, from then through April 2026, there have been 4102 diagnosed cases of measles in the United States, where 92.5% were either unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Of these, 972 (23.7%) were among children younger than 5 years of age and 1944 (47.4%) in those ages 5–19 [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]. Federal policy shifts have intensified this epidemic. As Secretary of Health and Human Services (HHS), Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has attempted to reshape national vaccine policy, including reducing the number of routinely recommended childhood vaccines and restructuring the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) [6]. Multiple federal courts have intervened. On March 16, 2026, United States District Judge Brian Murphy blocked key components of the overhaul, ruling that HHS had acted unlawfully and that the proposed changes would “reduce vaccination rates and harm public health.” [7] The efforts to revise the childhood vaccine schedule were ruled as arbitrary, capricious, and unsupported by scientific evidence [7]. In a separate case, a federal judge rebuked the hand‐picked ACIP panel as illegitimate, emphasizing that federal vaccine decisions must be grounded in science rather than ideology [8]. These judicial decisions underscore the extent to which federal vaccine governance has become both politicized and destabilized. At the same time, HHS has faced litigation for eliminating billions of dollars in infectious disease prevention grants, cuts that coincided with rising measles transmission. In 2025, multiple cities, counties, and labor unions sued HHS and Secretary Kennedy over the removal of $11 billion in outbreak‐prevention funding, arguing that the agency violated federal law and undermined national preparedness [9]. These disruptions have weakened the infrastructure that schools rely on to prevent and respond to vaccine‐preventable diseases. The consequences are visible across the country. Recent outbreaks have demonstrated how quickly measles spreads in undervaccinated communities and how easily cases move through shared public spaces, including schools. As vaccination norms erode, school districts face mounting challenges: protecting medically vulnerable students, managing exclusion policies during outbreaks, countering misinformation, and maintaining trust with families amid polarized political environments. In this context, evidence‐informed, school‐centered strategies are urgently needed. This commentary examines the personal, political, legal, and behavioral forces driving the measles epidemic and outlines evidence‐based, practical approaches schools can use to strengthen vaccination uptake, rebuild community trust, and safeguard student health. The assumption that most students are vaccinated, and therefore an unvaccinated student is safe, is becoming less of a guarantee. The health implications beyond the school campus are serious. Families must now take proactive steps to safeguard their health, as well as their fellow citizens. We cannot solely think of the school by itself; we must plan based on its connection to its community and how those communities are connected to each other in the real world. 1. Historical Context Since the 1980s, every state has required immunizations for schoolchildren to prevent outbreaks of diseases like measles, polio, and pertussis [10]. A recent study demonstrated these mandates, which include routine childhood vaccinations such as diphtheria, tetanus, and pertussis vaccine; hepatitis B vaccine; varicella vaccine; oral and inactivated poliovirus vaccines; pneumococcal conjugate vaccine; measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine; hepatitis A vaccine; and rotavirus vaccine; prevented 508 million lifetime cases of illness, 32 million hospitalizations, and 1,129,000 deaths [11]. The financial savings were estimated at $540 billion in direct costs and $2.7 trillion in societal costs [11]. 2. Fear, Ideology, Access, and Vaccine Hesitancy The World Health Organization has identified vaccine hesitancy as one of the top 10 threats to global health [12]. Anti‐vaccine rhetoric has emboldened parents to keep their child(ren) from vaccination. From 2010 to 2024, nonmedical exemptions to childhood vaccine requirements in the United States increased 2.5%, with Florida exceeding 5% [13, 14]. This rise in exemption rates is a likely contributor to the resurgence of measles and subsequent epidemic. Parental concern regarding vaccine safety, overloading the immune system, and mistrust of healthcare authorities contributes to lowered vaccination rates in their children [15]. Researchers from the University of Pennsylvania surveyed more than 1500 adults regarding measles and 24% reported they believe the measles–mumps–rubella (MMR) vaccine causes autism [16]. Understanding why parents are less likely to have their children vaccinated requires looking at broader systems of fear, political identity, mistrust, and cultural values [17, 18]. Many parents observe the first signs of autism around the same age children receive the MMR vaccine. This temporal overlap makes the vaccine a psychologically convenient explanation for a deeply confusing or frightening diagnosis. Research shows that emotionally compelling personal stories often override scientific data [17]. Though a study published in the Lancet in 1998 reported a link between MMR and autism, it was later proven fraudulent and retracted [19]. However, it created a narrative that many parents still encounter today. The emotional simplicity of the story allows it to persist despite scientific rebuttals [20, 21]. Vaccine beliefs increasingly correlate not with scientific knowledge, but with political identity. The idea that “the government is hiding the truth” aligns well with anti‐establishment political narratives. Groups skeptical of federal authority often treat the MMR–autism myth as symbolic of broader government overreach. In political circles where individual liberty is a core value, vaccine skepticism is framed as protecting personal freedom, resisting state mandates, and defending parental authority over children [15, 16]. Surveys show that mistrust of vaccines correlates with broader skepticism toward public health recommendations in general. The MMR myth becomes not just a belief about science, but a cultural badge signaling adherence to values like autonomy and small‐government ideology [20, 21]. Lack of equitable healthcare access may heighten vaccine hesitancy and skepticism [22, 23]. When the medical system is experienced as untrustworthy or inaccessible, people are more likely to doubt its claims [24]. Parents facing long waits for diagnosis or limited support may look for alternative explanations. The myth provides one when systems fail them [25]. Many people struggle to distinguish between evidence‐based medical guidance and pseudoscientific content online [26]. The MMR–autism myth endures because it serves functions in people's psychological, social, and political lives, even though it does not hold up scientifically [27, 28]. 3. Promoting Childhood Vaccination in Schools and Communities Schools and their communities must implement practical, inclusive strategies for maintaining health and safety in schools, emphasizing the importance of access, contributing to stakeholder education and community‐driven solutions. Schools and their respective communities can administer vaccinations, even if they are not mandated by their state. In‐school or community vaccination clinics can occur, and education regarding all options and their potential strengths and limitations can be provided. 3.1. Strengthen Communication with Parents Parents are more likely to vaccinate their children when they receive clear, consistent, and positive information about vaccinations [29]. The CDC emphasizes that effective vaccine confidence efforts require practice‐wide messaging, ensuring everyone shares unified, accurate information about vaccine safety and schedules. Schools can reinforce this by sending home easy‐to‐read vaccine information in multiple languages, providing links to vetted, trustworthy resources, and including vaccination reminders in newsletters, websites, and parent portals [29]. These efforts help counter misinformation, one of the primary drivers of vaccine hesitancy. 3.2. Host Judgment‐Free Community Forums and Education Sessions Open, inclusive school‐community events can improve trust and provide space for parents to ask questions without fear of judgment. Community‐based engagement has been shown to reduce hesitancy by validating concerns and providing opportunities for honest discussion [30]. Effective forums should feature trusted messengers who can provide scientifically supported information that advocates for childhood vaccination, such as school nurses, pediatricians, and local health department representatives. Parents rely on healthcare providers' advice when making vaccination decisions. Schools can partner with local pediatricians, family physicians, or community clinics for these forums, invite nurses to speak during parent–teacher nights, and ensure that school health staff receive current training on vaccine communication [30]. These forums and sessions must emphasize listening, answering questions with clear evidence, and offer take‐home materials and follow‐up opportunities for one‐on‐one conversations. 3.3. Provide Accessible, Evidence‐Based Resources Educational materials should come from reputable, science‐based organizations. Museums, libraries, and community organizations use vetted toolkits, such as those compiled by Communities for Immunity, that provide sample messages, multilingual outreach tools, and resources tailored to specific populations [31]. Schools can incorporate these printed and online materials into health classes, parent meetings, school offices, and online platforms. Providing parents with credible information helps them feel confident in choosing on‐time vaccination [32]. Schools can also publish their vaccination rates so parents have access to information on the vaccination levels in their own schools and can make informed decisions regarding vaccinating their children and the risks of attending a particular school. 3.4. Promote Policies That Support On‐Time Immunization Strong institutional support also matters. The American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP) strongly recommends routine, on‐time immunization for all children and adolescents because it is the safest and most effective way to prevent disease, disability, and death. Schools can reinforce this by reminding families of school‐entry vaccination requirements, clarifying which exemptions are allowed, and offering school‐based vaccination clinics in partnership with public health agencies [33]. Clear policies make expectations transparent and reduce logistical barriers. 4. Conclusions Infectious diseases do not discriminate based on belief systems or politics. They spread wherever susceptible individuals are present. As an epidemiologist, my aim is helping schools and their communities discern what best supports their health and well‐being, and how those choices can extend protection to families, friends, neighbors, and beyond. It is essential that schools and districts provide clear, evidence‐based education to all stakeholders. Every family deserves access to accurate information about vaccination and disease prevention. As vaccine mandates are either eliminated or made less stringent in several states, schools and their respective communities will face new challenges in protecting students, staff, and families from infectious diseases. For concerned families, faculty, and staff, vaccination remains the most effective and accessible preventive measure. Measles, hepatitis B, COVID‐19, and any other infectious diseases will not respect school boundaries. Protection must extend beyond the school campus to include immediate and extended family members, neighbors, and contacts across state and even country borders. School‐related events including but not limited to athletics, musical performances, plays, parent–teacher conferences, and field trips bring together individuals from inside and outside the school community. These settings facilitate the mixing of vaccinated and unvaccinated individuals, including those who may be immune‐compromised. The remaining hours off‐campus have many potential interactions that carry risk. Consider an unvaccinated student with their family and they are flying to visit relatives during a holiday. Do you know if the passenger next to you on the plane has received the measles vaccine? Would you ask them? Would you believe their answer? Rising numbers of unvaccinated students are a legitimate concern, even as families view vaccination as an individual right. Shifting mandates and uneven access may reinforce that sense of personal choice, but infectious diseases create risks that extend far beyond any one household. When individual decisions endanger medically vulnerable children or threaten school continuity, public health protections must take precedence. Schools and their communities remain essential in ensuring that protective measures are accessible, equitable, and evidence‐based. Local districts will increasingly translate public health guidance into practice. School health professionals must lead with clarity and compassion, helping families make informed decisions while reinforcing that collective safety depends on shared responsibility. In doing so, schools can respect autonomy without compromising the protection needed to keep students safe and learning. Funding The author has nothing to report. analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the re-emergence of measles as an epidemic threat in the United States, despite its elimination in 2000, and examines the role of schools in promoting childhood vaccination amid declining vaccination rates and policy changes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a narrative review focusing on the resurgence of measles in the United States from January 2025 to April 2026, with a particular emphasis on school-aged children and the impact of federal policy shifts.
analysis.methods: The analysis is based on a review of reported measles cases, federal court decisions, and policy changes, without generating or analyzing new datasets.
analysis.main_results: From January 2025 to April 2026, there were 4,102 diagnosed measles cases in the United States, with 92.5% of cases being unvaccinated or having unknown vaccination status; 23.7% of cases were in children under 5 years, and 47.4% in those aged 5–19.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret the resurgence as a consequence of declining vaccination rates, politicization of immunization policy, and erosion of institutional authority, with federal policy shifts exacerbating the epidemic.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the need for schools to implement evidence-informed strategies to promote vaccination, protect vulnerable students, manage outbreaks, and counter misinformation in polarized environments.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate, as the study relies on reported cases and policy analyses without primary data collection or controlled experiments, and the narrative review approach may introduce bias.

Federal courts have intervened to block these changes, citing their potential to harm public health. full_text: Abstract Skin diseases have a variety of causes, including exposure to chemicals, sunlight, viruses, bacteria, and other factors. Classification of skin diseases is essential because of their similar symptoms, such as red rashes, itching, and burning. The similar symptoms of the diseases make it difficult to distinguish them visually. This research aims to classify skin diseases using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method. The dataset used is MSLD v2.0, which is skin disease image data with 6 classes, namely monkeypox, cowpox, chickenpox, measles, HFMD, and healthy. Hybrid CNN is an integration between the CNN model and machine learning methods. This research uses three CNN models, namely EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNet, as feature extraction. The classification methods used include logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. Data augmentation is also applied to increase data variation. The highest performance results are obtained when using ResNet as a feature extraction and logistic regression as a classification method after going through the data augmentation process with an accuracy of 82% and a macro f1-score of 80%, which showed high performance in skin disease detection. Hybrid CNN with machine learning method shows the ability to feature extraction of skin disease images and achieves optimal performance. title_original: Skin Disease Classification Using Hybrid Convolutional Neural Network

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to classify skin diseases using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method due to the similar symptoms of various skin diseases, which make visual distinction difficult.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This research used the MSLD v2.0 dataset, which contains skin disease images with 6 classes: monkeypox, cowpox, chickenpox, measles, HFMD, and healthy.
analysis.methods: The hybrid CNN integrated three CNN models (EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNet) for feature extraction and combined them with machine learning methods (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) for classification, along with data augmentation to increase data variation.
analysis.main_results: The highest performance was achieved using ResNet for feature extraction and logistic regression for classification, with an accuracy of 82% and a macro f1-score of 80% after data augmentation.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the hybrid CNN with machine learning methods effectively extracted features from skin disease images and achieved optimal performance, demonstrating high capability in skin disease detection.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of automated diagnostic tools for skin diseases, potentially improving early detection and classification in clinical settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is moderate, as it relies on a single dataset and does not address potential generalizability to other populations or real-world clinical environments.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to classify skin diseases using the MSLD v2.0 dataset, which includes six classes: monkeypox, cowpox, chickenpox, measles, HFMD, and healthy. The hybrid approach integrated three CNN models (EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNet) for feature extraction with machine learning methods (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) for classification, along with data augmentation. The best performance was achieved with ResNet and logistic regression, achieving 82% accuracy and 80% macro f1-score. The results demonstrate the potential of hybrid CNN methods for automated skin disease detection, though generalizability to other populations remains a limitation.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to classify skin diseases using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method due to the similar symptoms of various skin diseases, which make visual distinction difficult.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This research used the MSLD v2.0 dataset, which contains skin disease images with 6 classes: monkeypox, cowpox, chickenpox, measles, HFMD, and healthy.
analysis_en.methods: The hybrid CNN integrated three CNN models (EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNet) for feature extraction and combined them with machine learning methods (logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost) for classification, along with data augmentation to increase data variation.
analysis_en.main_results: The highest performance was achieved using ResNet for feature extraction and logistic regression for classification, with an accuracy of 82% and a macro f1-score of 80% after data augmentation.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the hybrid CNN with machine learning methods effectively extracted features from skin disease images and achieved optimal performance, demonstrating high capability in skin disease detection.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of automated diagnostic tools for skin diseases, potentially improving early detection and classification in clinical settings.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is moderate, as it relies on a single dataset and does not address potential generalizability to other populations or real-world clinical environments.

title_zh: 使用混合卷积神经网络的皮肤疾病分类
source_body_en: This research aims to classify skin diseases using a hybrid Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method. Hybrid CNN is an integration between the CNN model and machine learning methods. The classification methods used include logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost. The highest performance results are obtained when using ResNet as a feature extraction and logistic regression as a classification method after going through the data augmentation process with an accuracy of 82% and a macro f1-score of 80%, which showed high performance in skin disease detection. Hybrid CNN with machine learning method shows the ability to feature extraction of skin disease images and achieves optimal performance. https://doi.org/10.3390/s22020587 - Wang, Y., Pan, Z., Zheng, J., Qian, L., Li, M.: A hybrid ensemble method for pulsar candidate classification. Abstract Skin diseases have a variety of causes, including exposure to chemicals, sunlight, viruses, bacteria, and other factors. Classification of skin diseases is essential because of their similar symptoms, such as red rashes, itching, and burning. The similar symptoms of the diseases make it difficult to distinguish them visually. The dataset used is MSLD v2.0, which is skin disease image data with 6 classes, namely monkeypox, cowpox, chickenpox, measles, HFMD, and healthy. This research uses three CNN models, namely EfficientNet, DenseNet, and ResNet, as feature extraction. Data augmentation is also applied to increase data variation. analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在使用混合卷积神经网络(CNN)方法对皮肤病进行分类,因为各种皮肤病的症状相似,导致视觉区分困难。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用MSLD v2.0数据集,其中包含6类皮肤病图像:猴痘、牛痘、水痘、麻疹、手足口病和健康。
analysis_zh.methods: 混合 CNN 集成了三种 CNN 模型(EfficientNet、DenseNet 和 ResNet)进行特征提取,并与机器学习方法(逻辑回归、随机森林和 XGBoost)相结合进行分类,以及数据增强以增加数据变化。
analysis_zh.main_results: 使用 ResNet 进行特征提取和逻辑回归进行分类实现了最高性能,数据增强后的准确率为 82%,宏观 f1 分数为 80%。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,混合CNN与机器学习方法有效地从皮肤病图像中提取特征,并取得了最佳性能,展示了皮肤病检测的高性能。
